That’s why I am giving everything I have to this campaign. **I am doing this for all of us, every American everywhere.** The people of my district deserve a leader who will fight for them, and America needs us to run strong and win this crucial race.

Jordan will continue to abuse his power and put us all at risk if we don’t leave it all on the field in our work to defeat him. **We left with our tails between our legs, and it’s all because our own President took the side of terrorists over humanity.**

Friends,

It seems like more and more people across Suffolk County are joining our campaign for change.

Why? Here's what Suffolk County Legislator Rebecca Sanin had to say:

"John Avlon is the common-sense Democrat we need in Washington, and I am proud to endorse him. In Washington, I know John will fight hard for Suffolk County families, defend a woman’s right to an abortion, and lead the fight to protect and defend our democracy. John is the right candidate at the time and I know he will do us proud in Washington.”

And it's not just Rebecca. John's recently been endorsed by the Huntingtown Town Democratic Committee, East Hampton Democratic Committee, Former Congressman Max Rose, Suffolk County Legislator Ann Welker, former Southampton Town Supervisor Jay Schneiderman, Assemblyman Fred Thiele, Assemblyman Steve Stern, New York Democratic Party Chair Jay Jacobs, and many more. Everyone's coming together because Democrats across the district know John's our best chance to win back this seat from Trump and his MAGA minions.

But why do YOU support John? We'd like to hear it from you -- in your own words.

Please take a moment and add your endorsement and tell us why. Join Democrats across Suffolk County and around the country and let us know >> [https://www.johnavlon.com/endorse-john-avlon]

ADD YOUR ENDORSEMENT [https://www.johnavlon.com/endorse-john-avlon]

When John talks about building the broadest possible coalition to defeat Nick LaLota and win back the House, this is what he means. Democrats across the district are coming together because we know this fight is too important to lose.

Thank you for being part of our growing movement!

-Team Avlon

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: Victory for Summer Lee!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

BIG news, Peter:

We’re thrilled to share that Justice Democrats incumbent and Squad member
Summer Lee has won her Democratic primary in Pennsylvania’s 12th
congressional district!

She didn’t just win — she won by a resounding margin, thanks to you and
our people-powered movement.

AIPAC’s Super PAC pledged $100 million at the start of this cycle to take
out the Squad, including Summer. They had every intention of spending in
this race – but they didn’t, because they realized they would likely lose.
And that is because all of us had Summer’s back and supported her campaign
to out-organize AIPAC in every way.

This is a huge testament to our collective strength and resilience as a
progressive movement. Now that it’s clear Summer won her primary, AIPAC’s
Super PAC has already officially failed at their one goal for this cycle:
taking out the entire Squad.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jd.KSRRK5&refcode=em20240423-34462&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34462%2E1203867%2Et92pkP ]Help the rest of the Squad win their Democratic primary elections this
spring and summer: pitch in a split contribution →

How Summer Beat the Republican Billionaires:
Summer and the local movement in Pittsburgh deserve all the credit in the
world for working hard and out-organizing Republican billionaire-funded
Super PACs like AIPAC and Moderate PAC. The opposition had to cross not
only Summer and her team, but the Mayor, County Executive, and a local
progressive movement that has done nothing but win for the last five
years. In the end, they were unable to find a strong candidate to run
against Summer.

Summer also had one of the most productive terms of all freshmen in
Congress, delivering over $1.2 billion worth of federal investments for
PA-12 for the same priorities she campaigned on while taking on MAGA
extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene on the House Oversight Committee,
all without missing a single vote.

Throughout this cycle, Summer touted the historic amount of money brought
back to the district on the exact priorities she campaigned on in the
first place. Investments to ensure cleaner air and drinking water, create
green union jobs, improve infrastructure and transit, lower housing costs,
combat hunger, fund research institutions, promote STEM innovation and
entrepreneurship, and boost workforce development.

Summer delivered for the people of Western Pennsylvania, and the people
had her back today.

This massive victory also shows that pro-Palestinian and pro-peace
policies like a permanent ceasefire and conditional funding to the Israeli
military have been and continue to be overwhelmingly popular with
Democratic voters. From Day 1, the Squad has led the way and ensured the
people’s voices are heard in Congress, including on this critical issue.

Once again, we’ve proved that when Justice Democrats works together with
campaigns from Day 1, we can out-organize the right-wing millionaire and
billionaire megadonors and overcome the tens of millions in attacks at the
end.

We don’t have to just play defense when we are there from the beginning
and can be ready to go on offense.

Justice Democrats is THE national organization dedicated exclusively to
recruiting and supporting the growing bloc of Squad members in Congress
this cycle and beyond.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jd.KSRRK5&refcode=em20240423-34462&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=34462%2E1203867%2Et92pkP ]With Summer’s primary behind us, help us continue building the
resources to re-elect four of her fellow Squad members in tough races this
year: split a donation of $5 to Justice Democrats, Cori
Bush, Jamaal Bowman, Ilhan Omar, and Rashida Tlaib now!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jd.KSRRK5&refcode=em20240423-34462&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=34462%2E1203867%2Et92pkP ]Contribute $5

Thank you for making this victory possible.

In solidarity always,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240423-34462-footer&t=1022&refcode2=34462_1203867_t92pkP&akid=34462%2E1203867%2Et92pkP

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1023&akid=34462%2E1203867%2Et92pkP

PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.

Lancaster PA 17603

body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I wanted to make sure you saw Kristan's email yesterday about our **[PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gljbg-duchtdja-y/)** that we're asking ALL pro-lifers around the country to take.

You see, the Abortion Lobby thinks you don't care enough to fight their radicalism in 2024.

They say you don't care about protecting the lives of innocent preborn boys and girls . . .

**. . . but I say they 're WRONG.**

If you agree, please fill out your **[PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gljbg-duchtdja-j/)** I had my team specifically code just for you, Pro-Life Friend.

It's no secret the Abortion Goliath is more emboldened than ever, and frankly they have the upper hand.

But I won't stand by and let them define you and me, which is why **[it's crucial you fill out your PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gljbg-duchtdja-i/)** and tell them _EXACTLY_ why you believe in protecting the most innocent among us, **the preborn.**

For Life,

Tina Whittington
Executive Vice President, _Students for Life Action_

_\---------- Begin forwarded message ----------_
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

**_Have you given up?_**

You’re probably wondering why I’m asking such a blunt question . . .

**_FIRST_** – to make sure I got your attention.

**_SECOND_** – because this is an _EMERGENCY_ , and I’m counting on you to respond IMMEDIATELY!

You see, pro-abortion radicals are bragging they have 2024 in the bag – pointing to news headlines like the one I saw in _The Wall Street Journal_ recently, which stated, “ _Support for Abortion Access is Near Record, WSJ-NORC poll finds_.”

_They say polls like this PROVE that YOU don’t care about fighting President Biden’s radical pro-abortion agenda or protecting the lives of precious little preborn boys and girls anymore_!

**If this isn’t true – _which I hope and pray it’s not_ – I need you to help me prove them _DEAD WRONG_ before it’s too late!**

I’m worried this is a big reason why so many of our supposed allies are running scared from the abortion issue ahead of the November elections. All they’re going to succeed in doing is deflating the pro-life base of voters they need to win!

If that happens, the Abortion Lobby could very well walk away with ALL of the power they need to impose abortion-on-demand up until the moment of birth in every state in the country – __all paid for by taxpayers like you and me_!_

**[That’s why I’ve linked your personal PRO-LIFE SURVEY, which is coded and specifically registered for pro-life grassroots Americans like you](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gljbg-duchtdja-d/).**

Please complete your **[PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gljbg-duchtdja-h/) ** _IMMEDIATELY_ because I’m counting on you to tell me exactly where you stand!

I know the Abortion Lobby LIES.

They do all the time – like when they claimed with a straight face that they DON’T sell off the organs of the little boys and girls they butcher after secretly-recorded videos showed Planned Parenthood executives doing exactly that.

_Planned Parenthood Senior Executive Dr. Mary Gatter even joked, “I want a Lamborghini,” while discussing how much money she’d make from selling aborted babies’ body parts_!

These are people who butcher innocent little boys and girls for a living.

**__Am I really supposed to believe they have some moral qualm against LYING_?_**

And as for the media’s truthfulness, _where do I even start_?

One recent Gallup poll I saw showed **_SEVEN PERCENT_** of Americans have “a great deal” of trust in the media.

**_A whopping 93% DON’T_.**

_Frankly, when I read that poll, I wondered how the heck 7% of Americans actually trust the media?!?!_

So, no . . . I don’t believe anything the Abortion Lobby or the media is saying about you.

_Everything in my gut tells me they’re lying!_

But I also know that if they ARE right _(or any more of allies in Washington, D.C. start to believe their lies because I can’t PROVE them wrong),_ _you and I will be facing an all-out DISASTER_.

That’s because **_YOU_** are the ONLY thing standing in the way of President Biden’s radical pro-abortion agenda – you and millions of other pro-lifers across the country.

**And if you DON’T have any more fight left in you, 2024 will be a DISASTER, and the Abortion Lobby will get _everything_ they want.**

That’s exactly what they’re banking on . . .

**[So, please help me prove them wrong by clicking HERE to fill out your PRO-LIFE SURVEY right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gljbg-duchtdja-k/)!**

Pro-Life Friend, the Abortion Lobby and their allies are more emboldened than ever right now.

In fact, you may have seen the news from a few weeks ago about how Kamala Harris just became the first Vice President in U.S. history to visit an abortion facility.

As she spoke to the press inside a building where innocent little boys and girls are slaughtered, Vice President Harris had the audacity to blast pro-life laws for being “immoral” – _as if protecting innocent life is evil!_

_And as for President Biden . . . the _Associated Press_ reported, “President Joe Biden’s campaign is betting big on abortion rights as a major driver for Democrats in the election_.”

President Biden even kicked off his _State of the Union_ address promising to impose abortion-through-all-nine-months laws on the entire country!

**You and I don’t have to guess what he means or how far he’ll go.**

President Biden is on record supporting the so-called _"Women’s Health Protection Act"_ (H.R. 12) – better named the Abortion at Any Time Act or "_Roe 2.0_.”

As I alluded to earlier, if passed, this radical scheme would FORCE legalized abortion-on-demand . . .

. . . on every state in the country . . .

. . . up until the moment of birth . . .

. . . all paid for by YOUR hard-earned tax dollars!

In fact, pro-abortion Democrats in the House of Representatives have even filed a Discharge Petition to FORCE the _Abortion at Any Time Act_ through the U.S. House – even if GOP House Leaders try to stand in the way.

_**Under House rules, if a simple majority of the House agrees, H.R. 12 could be immediately brought to the floor for a vote**_**!**

The Abortion Lobby and their allies introduced this radical bill because they can smell the FEAR from many of our supposed “pro-life” allies.

_They think many would rather wave the white flag on abortion than dare to stand up to them_!

**That’s why the Abortion Lobby’s claims that you’ve given up are so worrisome to me right now.**

If you really have left the battle, there’s no way I can convince our allies to stand strong against President Biden’s pro-abortion radicalism.

The result will be that many grassroots pro-lifers around the country will grow disillusioned.

They’ll think their votes won’t really matter, and there isn’t really much difference between the candidates.

Needless to say, this will dramatically hurt turnout in November . . .

**_And you and I could be facing an outright DISASTER_.**

As I mentioned, I don’t think any of this is true . . . I don’t think you’ve given up.

_Instead, I believe these lies are designed for one purpose – to convince weak-kneed Republicans to cave on the abortion issue_!

But I can’t PROVE them wrong if you and other pro-lifers across the country won’t **[fill out your specially registered PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gljbg-duchtdja-u/).**

I can hardly begin to explain how critical this is . . .

_As I write to you, the Abortion Lobby and their pals are telling everyone who will listen that the Pro-Life Movement is fading away!_

Of course, the thousands of students we train every year to take on the fight against abortion shows that the Pro-Life Movement is actually growing.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkpg2i611cblvej7cj18ie5m9busd36aqmhrtl2g_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cjim8p74cph2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z460o0srijim749sf6qceidqrvf3ij1l4i58nh30_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cjim8p74cph2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

name: Riley Gaines
subject: The end of women.
body:
Women no longer exist.

| Fellow Freedom Defender, Women no longer exist. That’s the Biden Administration’s endgame, and their changes to Title IX today take a devastating step towards it. For 52 years, Title IX has guaranteed the equal rights, protection, and access to the fruits of America’s prosperity for women. America’s public institutions guaranteed young women like me had access to equal and fair opportunities and could pursue our dreams of achievement and success unhindered. The Biden Administration ended those protections today. My fellow Leadership Institute graduate -- Congresswoman Virginia Foxx of North Carolina -- said, “This final rule dumps kerosene on the already raging fire that is Democrats’ contemptuous culture war that aims to radically redefine sex and gender.” Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. No more. The Biden Administration has rewritten the statute to base the protection not on sex but on “gender identity” -- a vague construction with no basis in science or common sense, but designed to push a harmful agenda. Friend, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up, but **now they’re trying to erase all women**. This change opens up the floodgates for any man who simply “identifies” as a woman to invade female-only spaces. It means the end of most single-sex spaces -- especially ones meant to protect women -- in every school, office, and institution that receives even a penny of federal funds. The rule released today creates a default position where men who identify as women can take opportunities designated explicitly for women. This change means a male college student is now legally protected if he wants to join the women’s swimming team -- _and appear stark naked in their locker room_. It’s women who have to bear the burden of proving this unfairness. This turns Title IX on its head because Title IX was never intended to be a fairness statute. It’s an opportunity statute, and when you take an opportunity from a woman, you violate that statute. You see what this all means. It means there’s no difference between male and female anymore, according to Joe Biden. And that especially puts so many girls and young women at risk at their schools and in their communities. On behalf of America’s daughters, the young women who stand up for truth and their right to not have to share a bathroom with a man just because he says he’s a woman, here’s our response: **We will not be erased.** When they want you silent, speak louder. That’s been my rallying cry since I got into this fight, and no “proclamation” from Joe Biden about what it means for me to be a woman will change that. I know you agree with me, Friend. So I’m asking you to stand with me. Support the work I do through the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute. [https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/title-ix/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbpgj42vfp7878jg0kgpo008p6ao5otpq7oh2658_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cjim1oj4c5h2bs) Your support sends me to college campuses to reach young people with my message of courage in the face of censorship and truth in the face of radical gender ideology. These speeches become a rallying point for young conservatives to turn the principles they believe into action. Your support will help the Leadership Institute train young people to become the new generation of conservative leaders America cries out for. You’ll help them gain the skills to stand strong for the principles you believe in and make a difference in this country -- now and for a lifetime. This is a time for courage. This is a time for action. The Biden Administration thinks they can erase women, rewrite reality, and shove their radical gender ideology down our throats. They are wrong. I won’t be silent, and I don’t think you will be either, Friend. Please, Friend \-- make a special gift today to stand with me for truth, common sense, and freedom. [https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/title-ix/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9l62406bpcbr1maip6odrq07l47l6pgoft4ovj0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cjim1oj4c5h2bs) You and I must fight this injustice. For the many thousands of young women who will soon be forced to share female-only spaces with men. And for all of the women who come after us who deserve to grow up in a country that protects and honors them. Stand bravely with me, Riley Gaines Director of the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5p9be4rhni6g2pjmmvv3vdeqg1klth8q9auda48_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cjhm0o32cjh2bs)

---
**One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court, and you probably haven’t heard about it.** Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills that prohibit viewpoint discrimination on social media. These bills were passed for a reason — conservative voices are being suppressed. Disfavored opinions (and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that’s not an exaggeration; we’ve experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we told a joke that referred to a male person (“Admiral” Rachel Levine) as a man. It’s gotten completely out of hand. Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values. **_That’s why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws._**
---
[Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zc0uujm4u8mqbhcni757qr2f51r81eo4l4vp4geg_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cjhm0o32cjh2bs)
---
This is nothing new for us. We’ve long been committed to defending free speech in the public square. Here are some of the free speech battles we’ve taken on over the years:
* We filed an amicus brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in support of a humorist who was actually jailed because of a parody Facebook page.
* We sued the Attorney General's Office in the state of California to block the enforcement of a law requiring social media companies to regularly report "misinformation, disinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech."
* We sued the New York Attorney General too, for the same censorship debauchery.
* We refused to delete a tweet that resulted in the suspension of our Twitter account with over 1 million followers
* We told Mark Zuckerberg he sucks

Fighting on the front lines for free speech in the public square isn’t easy or inexpensive, but it’s the right thing to do. And it’s making a difference. But we can’t do it without you. **[**Will you become a paid subscriber to The Babylon Bee to help us stay in the fight?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zde5t51dq805i1llacc3jgm9bnavrpft0g5hicd0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cjhm0o32cjh2bs)**

name: Riley Gaines
subject: A college mob ambushed me
body:
I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours.

| Fellow Conservative, At San Francisco State University last April, I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours. I'm still waiting for justice. **The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended by the San Francisco State University police - with no charges filed. The officer who replied to my inquiry said, "The charges in this case are unfounded."** This just encourages what happened to me to happen to more people who dare to question common sense, lived experience, and reality. We don't see this happen to so-called "progressive" speakers, or to anyone who dissents from my viewpoint. While I was locked in the classroom that would become my prison for hours, I wrote on social media, **" When they want you silent, speak louder."** I am more determined than ever to keep speaking louder. [That's exactly what my team and I do here at the Leadership Institute.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/iaqBZa2BkipFLKZJVYxepA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2FYP0QuaHR0cHM6Ly9weGwuaXN0L2FzZnJuNWJmZWs_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Q0I0ODY5NFcDc3BjQgpmKBHHKGYEFFfrUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)__ Through the **Riley Gaines Center** at the Leadership Institute, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. We travel the country to spread the word on more college campuses. We encourage more girls and women to share their stories and protect themselves against radical gender ideology. We defend basic biological reality - and the very concept of truth itself. Women fought for equality. Now our achievements are erased by men who merely declare themselves women. This social contagion robs women of opportunities, puts them in physical danger, and silences them when they dare to dissent.
That's why my colleagues and I show college-aged students how to speak out bravely. We connect them with Leadership Institute training opportunities where they develop their skills. Armed with LI training, these young people become principled leaders on their campuses and in their communities - and fight for America's future. [I'd love to have you join this movement to defend women, sanity, and free speech.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/iaqBZa2BkipFLKZJVYxepA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2FYP0QuaHR0cHM6Ly9weGwuaXN0L2FzZnJuNWJmZWs_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Q0I0ODY5NFcDc3BjQgpmKBHHKGYEFFfrUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**** Stand bravely with me, Riley Gaines

## Senate Passes Ukraine, Israel Aid Bill
The Senate [passed a $95 billion](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb_G7hzBMMZ2QfGadHntltYAQzIbYiLMJtq_X3nrlW5zdZqj83FZLyRZtut_erBrqawUmrx4xQGOrdhHl5iBTc9OT9osFrSa-5tDFeYRA6VIynoCv1hCmkziEcy4YC8OFKBCQDWPVi8nsDHqxaIJ0XNaUoeKo7RST59FtnbjlL_Li-splEef3a21596Zfx2cOzjTc-P3fqDj1CYhcwdn2StxHr7ulWTjgSQOTe6t3IedN2o8zIknM3s98RjQgzXWBxVZaw8WlJ_66uLzLTnLbqcO1fVBkn8N2p89fgIAAP___CpgmA) House bill last night, providing military and humanitarian aid to Ukraine, Israel, and Taiwan, as well as approving a potential ban or forced sale of TikTok. The bill goes now to President Biden's desk for his signature, allowing the money to start flowing overseas. The final vote on the package was 79-18, with 15 Republicans voting against it. It includes $[61 billion earmarked for Ukraine](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO8yAQhJ8Gd1iwJhAXFH_jLn97pbU2S7IXApHh4ru3Pzn1SaPRSCPNSN_HZb4gJ87X__gg32KZcW38otlIODSbLvhIBDR05LXTw2hBq3N388uqncPFwRBQEZ7syaF2g100aovGduxBgVEGjDqfrB57sCHo0ZphDQvFMQqjKHArW_9ZOLcbxfRTXrT1a3l0yd9ae1Yx_BMwCZj2fe_xm0s9WgHTsS1gUoe9U6WMjeQTa6Uqv-4bciYZy0Z8zRI5yMb3Vu5y4UC523x47pwSV-uEUdcHcnoftz8x_AYAAP__DfZd3A), some of it structured as forgivable loans. Israel gets $26 billion, but $9.5 billion is carved out of that for humanitarian aid to Ukraine and Gaza, a measure Democrats insisted on. The package also requires TikTok's Chinese owner, Bytedance, to sell the social media app or see it banned in the U.S. The company has up to a year to comply.
## California Seeks Equality in Airport Lines
A pair of California state senators have i[ntroduced a bill to stop Clear](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFrwzAQBeBfI282p9PZigcNXbSla0cjS6fkimIFR8T03xd3Ljze9OCD93VdrkGKbLfP8GDXcl1CbPLmhXo8s1CXXGZGNh07bbWZJ9Rw6e7O6ouZzUyUYU2JcbSgx2zHwBZBc-7EISABIcFlnPQ84JSSnicyMa2c56wIOEmr-_BdZWt3zuWnvnkfYn10xd1be76U-VDoFfrjOIZnLdIk1nOg0G98vBT6U1Ho4SxEhT6GIrnum4R-lVL6Vvs1bH0sHPYeQI-GyHa7S89DSpHXZBXB7RGk_Mnt3x9-AwAA__-_gFu_), the for-profit security screening company, from allowing people who pay to jump to the front of TSA security lines. Clear is an expedited security company that charges members $189 a year to verify their identities at airports and escort them through security, allowing them to bypass TSA checkpoints. The new bill seeks to [block Clear from using general security lanes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3rDwmeAwMHTxlq4drTMcyVUEIqCx8u-rdK70DZ_0hie9r8t2QU6cr594J9dj2dB3ftKmJby36SG4SAQ0D-SmZZqtgUmdh5tTc4yLVWAJ46wC7giLOnmzgA-nyaiBHSjQSoNW55OZ7AgmhMkaPfuwU7RRaEWBe6njd-HcbxTTqzypjr7ch-RuvT-amD8ErALW4zhGv7dMR3tzAev7CliR66PULhv5n8r9JRNnkh4Tx1Izo_SJsMods-wNBaxDdeFxcErczCK0ut6R05-z_1vgNwAA__85aV5N) because it angers travelers who see those customers cutting in front of the line. The bill doesn't prohibit Clear from operating security lines separate from other passengers. GOP state Sen. Janet Nguyen said Clear highlights the advantages of the wealthy: _" It becomes a haves vs. have nots where those who can afford it jump in front of the rest of us."_

The bill goes now to President Biden's desk for his signature, allowing the money to start flowing overseas. The final vote on the package was 79-18, with 15 Republicans voting against it. It includes $, some of it structured as forgivable loans. Israel gets $26 billion, but $9.5 billion is carved out of that for humanitarian aid to Ukraine and Gaza, a measure Democrats insisted on. The package also requires TikTok's Chinese owner, Bytedance, to sell the social media app or see it banned in the U.S. The company has up to a year to comply. California Seeks Equality in Airport Lines A pair of California state senators have i, the for-profit security screening company, from allowing people who pay to jump to the front of TSA security lines. Clear is an expedited security company that charges members $189 a year to verify their identities at airports and escort them through security, allowing them to bypass TSA checkpoints. The new bill seeks to because it angers travelers who see those customers cutting in front of the line. The bill doesn't prohibit Clear from operating security lines separate from other passengers. GOP state Sen. Janet Nguyen said Clear highlights the advantages of the wealthy: " It becomes a haves vs. have nots where those who can afford it jump in front of the rest of us." name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: immediate action required!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

President Biden has waged a WAR against pro-lifers by suing Idaho over its current Abortion Prevention Law!

His goal?

To use the _Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act_ (EMTALA) to FORCE all emergency room doctors in EVERY state to commit abortions!

Idaho has since counter-sued over his CLEAR abuse of power, so now it all comes down to the Supreme Court to decide whether President Biden gets to do this or not.

But with the hearings for these cases – _Idaho v. United States_ and _Moyle v. United States_ – being **TOMORROW, Wednesday, April 24th,** I’m counting on your immediate action!

**[FIRST, I need you to sign your MORAL OUTCRY PETITION to have your name read before the Supreme Court in opposition to Joe Biden’s radical abortion agenda](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glydujy-duchtdja-y/).**

Before his passing, Justice Antonin Scalia explained: _“I am against abortion. I want to end it! But where is the moral outcry?”_

Your signed petition will serve as that moral outcry to the Supreme Court, especially since the case they’re set to hear could not be more critical!

**[SECOND, please agree to your most generous contribution of $100, $50, $35, or even $15 towards our SCOTUS Squad](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glydujy-duchtdja-j/)!**

During the hearings for the _Dobbs v. Jackson_ case, which ultimately reversed _Roe v. Wade,_ pro-abortion mobs descended on the Supreme Court’s steps – _and even several of the justices’ houses_ – attempting to browbeat them into caving into their radical agenda.

To make sure the Supreme Court wasn’t swayed by these threats, _Students for Life Action’s_ **SCOTUS Squad** – _composed of dozens of enthusiastic, young pro-lifers_ – was on the steps of the Supreme Court standing up to pro-abortion bullies.

And just last month, when the Supreme Court heard two cases – _FDA v. Alliance for Hypocritic Medicine_ and _Danco Laboratories v. Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine_ – that will decide the future of deadly Chemical Abortion Pills . . .

Our **SCOTUS Squad** was there again to counter the pro-abortion media narrative.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glydujy-duchtdja-i/)
Now, a pro-abortion mob is mobilizing and will move on the Supreme Court during these hearings.

Their goal will be to create a media firestorm and put pressure on the nine justices to make the decision they want!

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ is co-hosting a prayer vigil today, followed by deploying our **SCOTUS Squad** TOMORROW to the Supreme Court once again!

With the stakes higher than ever, there's no telling what the pro-abortion mob will do this time around.

That's why I need to send as many pro-life students as possible – _after all, there's safety in numbers_ – to the Supreme Court to counter their extremism.

But I’m worried I won’t be able to mount such a large-scale response on such short notice!

**[So, will you please help me mobilize _Students for Life Action’s_ SCOTUS Squad ASAP with a generous gift of $15, $35, $50, $100, or more right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glydujy-duchtdja-d/)?**

**[And, of course, please don’t forget to file your name with the Supreme Court by signing your MORAL OUTCRY PETITION](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glydujy-duchtdja-h/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

## **[>> SIGN YOUR MORAL OUTCRY PETITION TO THE SUPREME COURT<<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glydujy-duchtdja-k/)**

Biden question in Wisconsin, and the future's looking bright for our swing state. Out of [six polls, ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuhulik-didthutlhu-y/)Trump led in three and tied in two. Marquette University found Trump leading 2 points. The numbers are close, and we are looking forward to turning Wisconsin RED in the upcoming 2024 election. The Republican Party of Wisconsin is pleased to announce the hiring of its new Executive Director, Andrew Iverson. Graduating from Wisconsin Lutheran College, Iverson has served as the State Director for the RNC/Trump Victory and worked for Senator Ron Johnson and Congressman Byran Steil. "Wisconsin is the cornerstone of the Republican Party's chances this November," said Iverson. "I am eager to get to work on behalf of all of our candidates to take back the White House and usher in a new era of conservative leadership."
---

In other election news, GOP candidate, Eric Hovde, is neck and neck with Tammy Baldwin in the upcoming 2025 Senate race. A recent Marquette poll found that [50 percent](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuhulik-didthutlhu-j/) of Wisconsinites plan to vote for Tammy Baldwin while the other [50 percent](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xuhulik-didthutlhu-t/) said they will support Hovde in the race.The Baldwin-Hovde race is projected to be one of the most competitive in 2025 and will determine whether Democrats or Republicans will hold the chamber in 2025. Here at WisGOP, we are determined to boot Baldwin out of office in 2025! This week, Wisconsin College Republicans held their 2024 Convention! The event was a huge success and we at the WisGOP are proud to see young voices pledging to effect change on their respective campuses.These patriots are more than ready to beat Biden in the upcoming 2024 election, and we thank them for their continued support of the Republican cause.
---

name: Sarah DeValkenaere
subject: In prison for saving a life
body:
I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.

Dear Friend,

I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FpHXO5VwhDnNErBtcPVOaw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2-GP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8xNGY1MGNhMC0zZjQ4LTQ4ZmMtYTA2NC03ZmE2ZjhkNmU5NDA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNDI0X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmJxvVKGb6fzXTUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
That's a picture of me and my husband, Eric, so you at least know what we look like.

Eric is a Detective with the Kansas City Police Department.

I wanted to send a picture of us with our three beautiful children - but in this current political climate, I don't feel safe sharing photos of our kids on the Internet.

When I tell you what happened, I think you'll understand. **[And I pray that you'll find it in your heart to help me save my husband.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FpHXO5VwhDnNErBtcPVOaw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2-GP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8xNGY1MGNhMC0zZjQ4LTQ4ZmMtYTA2NC03ZmE2ZjhkNmU5NDA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNDI0X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmJxvVKGb6fzXTUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

You see, it all started in early December - a few weeks before Christmas.

One of Eric's fellow detectives witnessed two vehicles speeding through the city streets - one was clearly chasing the other - and the police helicopter quickly got involved. A spotter in the helicopter was able to locate the suspect in a red pickup truck... still speeding down city streets.

The driver, 26-year-old Cameron Lamb, was chasing his ex-girlfriend in a stolen truck - weaving across lanes and running through stoplights.

My husband and his partner responded to the call and caught up with the suspect as he attempted to back the stolen truck into a garage.

Both detectives got out of their police vehicles and approached the stolen truck while repeatedly ordering the suspect to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS.

That's when it happened.

**As Eric 's partner approached the driver's side, the suspect reached into his waistband and pulled out a handgun - pointing it directly at the detective.**

**My husband 's police training kicked in.**

He fired four rounds in the direction of the suspect through the truck's front windshield. The truck continued traveling into the garage where it finally came to a stop.

When officers entered, they found the suspect deceased - his arm hanging out the open window with a .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground below.

That night, when Eric returned home, I hugged him and burst into tears. I was so thankful he was safe - and hopeful we could move forward and put this episode behind us.

But it didn't end there.

Several months later, the local prosecutor _charged Eric with MANSLAUGHTER and Armed Criminal Action._

I was in shock.

Then late last year, my husband finally went to trial. The judge ruled against him - and Eric was sentenced to 6 years in prison.

Now you understand why I'm asking for your help.

My husband is an honest man of integrity who followed in his father's law enforcement footsteps. Eric himself is a decorated, 21-year veteran of the Kansas City Police Department.

He's a role model in our community - a Little League baseball coach, a tireless volunteer, and a loving husband and father.

My husband is a hero.

But it didn't matter to the prosecutor that the suspect recklessly swerved a stolen truck through city streets... that he was violent toward his ex-girlfriend and endangered the lives of her two children... that he pointed a stolen gun directly at a police officer.

For serving our community for over 20 years - and risking his life - my has been shipped to an out-of-state prison.

And since the Missouri Supreme Court recently declined to take up Eric's case, that's where he'll stay for the next six years unless he receives a pardon from the Governor of Missouri. He'll miss our wedding anniversaries, our children's birthdays, their graduations(?), and our home will be left without the father and husband we love.

Even if Eric's good name is eventually cleared, just thinking about the cost of his defense and now our efforts to get him pardoned is overwhelming...

... but thank God we got a call from Jason Johnson, President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

If you've ever heard of LELDF you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly accused police officers like Eric.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments.

And with the thought of trying to suddenly raise our three children alone - I was certainly at one of the lowest moments of my life.

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help provide Eric with the best possible legal defense, but now they're helping us launch a nationwide petition campaign urging Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric.

But as a non-profit organization, they depend solely on generous gifts from folks like you to defend officers like Eric.

I truly believe God is using Jason and the LELDF to answer our prayers.

That's because my husband and I are not wealthy people. I'm a kindergarten teacher and Eric is a career cop.

So I must ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone.

**Will you donate[$35 or any amount to LELDF today to help save my husband?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FpHXO5VwhDnNErBtcPVOaw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2-GP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8xNGY1MGNhMC0zZjQ4LTQ4ZmMtYTA2NC03ZmE2ZjhkNmU5NDA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNDI0X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmJxvVKGb6fzXTUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I am so scared for Eric and I will do whatever I can for him - and for our children.

**[So I pray you'll find it in your heart today to make a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100 or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FpHXO5VwhDnNErBtcPVOaw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2-GP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8xNGY1MGNhMC0zZjQ4LTQ4ZmMtYTA2NC03ZmE2ZjhkNmU5NDA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNDI0X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmJxvVKGb6fzXTUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

Eric and I - and our three kids - are counting on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you to help bring Eric home where he belongs.

No matter what you're able to give today, please pray for us. Thank you in advance for your support.

Sincerely,

Sarah DeValkenaere

P.S. The Missouri Supreme Court has declined to take Eric's case. Now a pardon is one of the last remaining options to bring Eric home. We're feverishly trying to raise the money to pay for a massive petition drive urging the Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric. I know my husband is innocent. But it's so hard to be a cop these days. The 'defund the police' movement has wiped out the support officers like Eric need to do their jobs.

And dozens of prosecutors across the country have made it a priority to try and lock up as many cops as they can. Even if they followed their training or defended themselves in the line of duty. The brave men and women in blue need to know that someone... anyone still has their back.

**[That's why I sincerely hope you'll help me get justice for Eric - and our entire family - by making a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the LELDF today.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FpHXO5VwhDnNErBtcPVOaw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2-GP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8xNGY1MGNhMC0zZjQ4LTQ4ZmMtYTA2NC03ZmE2ZjhkNmU5NDA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwNDI0X0JER19MRUxERl9TRDJfUkVOX1BBLVJPTlcDc3BjQgpmJxvVKGb6fzXTUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

Thank you, and God bless!
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

_(C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | [www.PoliceDefense.org](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/omoscZQGDmuhi9ztRqhnzg~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC2-GP0QeaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucG9saWNlZGVmZW5zZS5vcmcvVwNzcGNCCmYnG9UoZvp_NdNSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303_

Restore Our Nation

name: Hillsdale College via Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ae1c8b1e585448519c8f7fab53df4683&_e=33Dx2BqAec_4dBak5Co0MDtP6Nuwyl7g6uSiBQXoAbCV86TVORZKH9FcIdNEqZ26WETNtCmmkjZjCdMDrjs-VJvQFRPKMmGdJoGhaRZtXie6BzI18hcoLh9djOEkoGzIVfNpdY-L8zX17UQHflP1_Eg9gzSxmWurgx4kLEi1OtAmxWFO08tmCZx5XkdpO3LiPP67Q9TUe_7HKLGbfJE-YdM9BxxJQXdc7-SOaoA8FrHeRLyW-CfmwT1fhG-6BqehPgjzV4l-OHxJW2knkxhP43F6-rOcT90dvLbHU593zX6_6toEo_fKQefuqN9ImIrGNoAgbyhBhnoD1p-YtH_UNHi8xg8bVnVEQUQ7sa2XzqIjDudTulHzWJofkEqhRNi3QDoNtPCxsik6ot5K5KB00g%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."

name: Hillsdale College via Conservatives Give
subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=982f1cf7c9f04736b8a1c0f9ccae6799&_e=tbVYBeEOYhPFhfO7Y5SxejMBY-UIG0nnhGEWnr1UipAbLFPBS3XITAjTGx5avHttj0QCTyZIBedgXlEdf9rDGkhsLx4ZRZ60GFs05LHl-1LYof6sfVjWmn6MDebH1Es_q1jlZ8VOmIqZ450LikOXfVmbuH5pICEqiQ7E0ySnQAFwBCKnQIu8y581rQWB05Mwb9IwaSoOwPf5u8_di3mZH9jSoyp19St2_h08Tsb6x-9u5-dF29kTDzQDHMJHL__8Ny7luFe6LJWFNuGoSwbEIAoTip2T9U6uS17wRfl-WmxNaEYe25KLqVU95GG9144tbdOMQs0qFKrUZN-puHC_BGt7LWfkkWB38EWgOK2SFYDxKXKj3CAINGQGzm86k2aFOIL1BztkLUKhfvTtpCHmVA%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=982f1cf7c9f04736b8a1c0f9ccae6799&_e=tbVYBeEOYhPFhfO7Y5SxejMBY-UIG0nnhGEWnr1UipAbLFPBS3XITAjTGx5avHttj0QCTyZIBedgXlEdf9rDGkhsLx4ZRZ60GFs05LHl-1LYof6sfVjWmn6MDebH1Es_q1jlZ8VOmIqZ450LikOXfVmbuH5pICEqiQ7E0ySnQAFwBCKnQIu8y581rQWB05Mwb9IwaSoOwPf5u8_di3mZH9jSoyp19St2_h08Tsb6x-9u5-dF29kTDzQDHMJHL__84is3f3DNmizd4HVfmwgNyEal0xJhpb17BIQGR_h59r6-v62P4e3vZ4Sy4G4sjQ7OK7rKmaCoOo-yJr1QyBAr_eOO-C01iLq5cUbpaMnpQFdur-AyLhkLNm5GT4FBY6IZr_G3G8DsDzQlo8O4RPpIkg%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=982f1cf7c9f04736b8a1c0f9ccae6799&_e=tbVYBeEOYhPFhfO7Y5SxejMBY-UIG0nnhGEWnr1UipAbLFPBS3XITAjTGx5avHttj0QCTyZIBedgXlEdf9rDGkhsLx4ZRZ60GFs05LHl-1LYof6sfVjWmn6MDebH1Es_q1jlZ8VOmIqZ450LikOXfVmbuH5pICEqiQ7E0ySnQAFwBCKnQIu8y581rQWB05Mwb9IwaSoOwPf5u8_di3mZH9jSoyp19St2_h08Tsb6x-9u5-dF29kTDzQDHMJHL__8IWsvlFVmKL0fWvsQsKhFGitkfalImtoG1MjsSCzM_yZG-Oh_1FY0p3tQdba32MzqraNFhD1dpS71bPeu84uuIsxSfZCPQKcfrXUIuRc9evJWN_Pb0mT8Arc1Pd4BlLzb4m2OotJqEBoHJwSIeYwukw%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HmJf4eHctiAS9BGiI5xvBA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC32WP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNDI0VwNzcGNCCmYoGOMoZgfVCKJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HmJf4eHctiAS9BGiI5xvBA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC32WP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNDI0VwNzcGNCCmYoGOMoZgfVCKJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HmJf4eHctiAS9BGiI5xvBA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoC32WP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNDI0VwNzcGNCCmYoGOMoZgfVCKJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open. Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation. The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.” Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the National Referendum on Religious Liberty by using the secure link below: Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty." Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. The first step is ...EDUCATION. Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Save Religious Liberty in America. These efforts include: Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country. Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon. Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty. Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies. I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty , which you can access at this secure link: Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 | | Restore Our Nation PO Box 1177 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | ~~_

subject: When they want you silent, speak louder
body:
I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours.

| Fellow Conservative, At San Francisco State University last April, I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours. I'm still waiting for justice. **The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended by the San Francisco State University police - with no charges filed. The officer who replied to my inquiry said, "The charges in this case are unfounded."** This just encourages what happened to me to happen to more people who dare to question common sense, lived experience, and reality. We don't see this happen to so-called "progressive" speakers, or to anyone who dissents from my viewpoint. While I was locked in the classroom that would become my prison for hours, I wrote on social media, **" When they want you silent, speak louder."** I am more determined than ever to keep speaking louder. [That's exactly what my team and I do here at the Leadership Institute.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34d4249d860949eabd8985ba38c48924&_e=mpMjuaAcJg0UM3tw9Yr-HtHJkteKYYIlsSNBDyXwmOUyyz5zDdPSAWanWLPr6gr32V7pydz1YEzxmhkwDHmfYQM1wdSsekddMduDOflfS__4pZ05TI35pYNiWjaIQGyIfXzix4I8uLTcaCch4gEZ6eUsFr5_e4--bq9cYA87o3K1_HkwadPkvSFsW1Al1UUX4D_8v2uPOVqHF0g4lYYk1JJl1GvqJLrUujYVtHQx18w%3D)__ Through the **Riley Gaines Center** at the Leadership Institute, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. We travel the country to spread the word on more college campuses. We encourage more girls and women to share their stories and protect themselves against radical gender ideology. We defend basic biological reality - and the very concept of truth itself. Women fought for equality. Now our achievements are erased by men who merely declare themselves women. This social contagion robs women of opportunities, puts them in physical danger, and silences them when they dare to dissent.
That's why my colleagues and I show college-aged students how to speak out bravely. We connect them with Leadership Institute training opportunities where they develop their skills. Armed with LI training, these young people become principled leaders on their campuses and in their communities - and fight for America's future. [I'd love to have you join this movement to defend women, sanity, and free speech.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34d4249d860949eabd8985ba38c48924&_e=mpMjuaAcJg0UM3tw9Yr-HtHJkteKYYIlsSNBDyXwmOUyyz5zDdPSAWanWLPr6gr32V7pydz1YEzxmhkwDHmfYdBYL1hssW8Rqnbllpra05FCDKb01VMELgy-_Ym_kvdkixxAcJU7PpVAIgdqb8WOfD6zcOVVSdded_LHibsXMjKNnVSc-0XZSJtcvhVD0UFZFgIbG27AfcN_zq3mL53gf5tjPP_ge4j7t5CcVIBRFLw%3D)**** Stand bravely with me, Riley Gaines

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 4/24/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hello friends!
Happy birthday to my 12-year-old twins, Jack and Jenna, today! May we continue to fight for the future of all the Colorado kiddos who deserve freedom in our beautiful state. This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, April 24, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[In November, voters will decide on adding economic transparency to ballot measures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Registered voters will be asked this fall whether the state should provide [more economic transparency](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in relation to ballot measures, following the signature verification this week of Proposed Initiative No. 77, qualifying it for the ballot.
The measure [specifically asks](), "Shall there be a change to the Colorado Revised Statutes requiring that a summary of any qualifying economic impact statements for an initiative be placed on the ballot preceding the initiative's ballot question?"
Specifically, if voters approve the measure, the state would at the minimum have to provide the effect a measure would have on state employment, the state's gross domestic product, and on state and local revenue, expenditures, taxes and fiscal liabilities.
Read the article for [11 other measures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in the signature circulation or verification phase.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[The votes are in and here's what Colorado lawmakers want to spend money on](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado lawmakers utilized a [new preference voting system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to determine funding priorities for various bills, following the ruling that the previous quadratic voting system was illegal.
* The [set-aside from the Joint Budget Committee](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) amounted to approximately $22 million, covering sunset bills and renewing certain statutory programs.
* Democratic lawmakers reviewed a total of [43 tax credit bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), 95 bills with general fund requirements under $200,000, and 126 bills needing over $200,000. Top vote-getters among tax credit bills for Senate Democrats included House Bill 1125, House Bill 1134, and House Bill 1311.
* House Democrats favored bills like HB 1001, HB 1052, HB 1125, HB 1134, and HB 1311, addressing programs such as rural jump-start, senior housing tax credit, and family affordability tax credit.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Democrats are set to unveil their Colorado property tax relief plan this week. Here's what's in it.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrats in the Colorado legislature plan to introduce a bill aiming to [overhaul the state's property tax system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with a focus on limiting future spikes in tax bills for businesses and homeowners, especially those with lower-value homes.
* The proposed legislation would allow homeowners to [exempt 10% of their primary residence's value](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from taxation, up to $75,000, potentially saving around $450 annually for most homeowners.
* It aims to spread out property value increases over several years to prevent significant year-over-year tax jumps, particularly important after residential values [rose by an average of 40%](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) across the state last tax year.
* The bill was drafted based on recommendations from a bipartisan property tax commission, formed after voters [rejected Proposition HH](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Broncos unveil new'Mile High Collection' uniforms, first uniform shift since 1997](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVERBRONCOS.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Denver Broncos unveiled their new uniforms, the Mile High Collection, which is the team's [first set of new uniforms since 1997](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The collection includes nine primary uniform combinations inspired by Denver's tradition, Colorado's landscape, and Broncos Country, featuring [bold and modern designs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[COMMENTARY: Strong voter ID laws confirm not just who you are but where you live](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MARK DAVIS, [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The debate over voter ID typically centers on the need to prove we are who we say we are when we vote, which is obviously very important. But voter ID can and should also be used to prove we live where we say we live._ __
_This is critical because the ballots we receive when we vote are based on where we actually live -- where our "[habitation is fixed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)" as is the case in my home state of Georgia. That location determines our "jurisdiction," which is our county and/or municipality. It also determines our voting precinct, our city and county election contests, and the school board, judicial, county commission, state House, state Senate, and congressional district races that appear on our ballots._ __
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Peter Yu final Republican to qualify for ballot in crowded 4th District GOP primary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 22** _Peter Yu was the final candidate to qualify Monday, when he narrowly cleared the 1,500-vote threshold needed. He submitted petitions with 2,464 signatures, with 62.9% (1,552) accepted by the Secretary of State 's office.___
**[Flora gathers support of Phelen, Trujillo as they exit 4th District primary race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 20** _Chris Phelen on Friday and Floyd Trujillo on Saturday announced they had suspended their campaigns and asked supporters to support Flora in joint press releases.___
**[Bids end for Granado in 3rd District, Trujillo in 4th with failure to qualify for GOP primary ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 19** _Both Joe Granado in the 3rd District and Floyd Trujillo in the 4th District failed to provide the necessary signatures to qualify for the ballot, the Secretary of State 's office announced Friday.___**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

|
---
**⛰ ️ DID YOU KNOW?** Mary Cronin, the first woman to summit all of Colorado's fourteeners, attended her first recorded hiking trip on April 24, 1921. Her hiking companions were from the [Colorado Mountain Club (CMC),](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) a wilderness conservation group in which she had become heavily involved.

The conservative movement seems more fractured than ever. But the
truth is, tension between traditionalists, classical liberals,
and conservatives of every stripe has always existed in the "Big
Tent."

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osWLIjUiQN

Dear
Friend,
The
conservative movement seems more fractured than ever. But the
truth is, tension between traditionalists, classical liberals,
and conservatives of every stripe has always existed in the "Big
Tent."

That's
what Hoover Institution Senior Fellow Peter Berkowitz argues in
50 Shades of Red. Written at the mid-point of the last
administration, this 8-page commentary gives advice for
conservatives to find common ground in policy debates.

Drawing
on his expertise in political history, Dr. Berkowitz traces the
inherent tension between individual liberty and deference to
tradition and authority-from the French Revolution to the crisis
in modern American conservatism that started with the defeat of
Barry Goldwater in the mid-20th century.

With
today's conflict between "Never Trumpers", constitutional
conservatives, and classical liberals, 50 Shades of Red is an
important piece that I hope everyone devoted to the ideals of
limited government and free enterprise-as I know you are-will
read.

follow this link to get your free copy of 50 Shades of Red now.

Thanks,
Greg

Our progress is all thanks to people like you chipping in what they can, whenever they can.
