Friends -
Let’s play a game of two truths and a lie:
The United States has higher rates of gun violence than any other developed country in the world. ✅
Gun violence is the NUMBER ONE cause of death for children and teens in the U.S. ✅
There’s nothing we can do to change this status quo. ❌
**Change is possible. And that’s where you come in.**
When you make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC, it goes directly towards our work to save lives from gun violence. There’s no doubt that some days are more difficult than others in this fight. But if you look at all we have done together in the past eleven years since GIFFORDS’ founding, the progress we’ve made is undeniable.
Gun safety used to be a political nonstarter. Now, candidates with comprehensive gun safety platforms run (and win!) elections at all levels of our government.
The tides are shifting, and it’s by no means a fluke. It’s all thanks to people like you chipping in what they can, whenever they can, to support GIFFORDS PAC and our work.

It seems like more and more people across Suffolk County are joining our campaign for change.

In Washington, I know John will fight hard for Suffolk County families, defend a woman’s right to an abortion, and lead the fight to protect and defend our democracy. | | 1\. Our New Vision Statement
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| | 2\. RAU: The Most Spectacular Way Forward
---
| | We at RAU could not be more grateful for the support and encouragement we have received. Our work continues to expand in ways that benefit the communities we serve, and we are ever respectful of the need to share power. No one person or organization can be successful alone; it takes many. We hope that RAU continues to earn the trust of our partners and the communities we serve. 2.1 Our pro-Democratic messaging campaign has been a huge success. We have delivered over twenty million messages to the far-flung corners of Central and Eastern Washington (C/EW). However, we recognize that this is not enough. RAU has evaluated this strategy and determined that we can deliver much greater value. In May/June, we will hold a workshop that will include local organizations, entities invested in the success of rural Washington, community representatives, communications specialists, and data analysts. Together, we will design a program utilizing social media, direct-to-IP, and other communication networks to create a messaging strategy aimed at reaching youth, marginalized populations, and low voter turnout demographics. This will be the largest initiative of its kind ever conducted in C/EW.Using technology and messaging strategies, we will "listen" to these groups to understand why they are disconnected from the political process. This information will be used to develop tailored messaging campaigns and programs to support these groups in ways that are most relevant to them. The insights gained will be shared with campaigns, policymakers, non-profits, and others whose true intent is to serve and support democratic values.
2.2 The Octogenarian Peace Brigade is the working title for Shirley Grossman and Roz Luther's project with Rural Americans United. Based in Spokane Valley, these two dynamos will be hitting the road, traveling to small towns up and down Congressional District 5. While there's still much planning to be done, the premise is simple: elevate the voice and visibility of rural America.
---
| |
---
|
---
| | By venturing into these small towns and either organizing events or participating in local ones, they aim to make marginalized people aware of their importance and to signal that work is underway to change the untenable circumstances they face due to far-right intimidation. Currently, we're reaching out to Democratic county parties in CD5 to seek permission and cooperation for this tour.We're fortunate to have experts like Glenn Rudolph, Chair of LD 13 (soon to become LD 15), lending their expertise. Glenn's understanding of one-on-one conversation techniques in far-right areas is invaluable.If you'd like more information or are able to support this project, please respond to this email or reach out to Shirley at emacap@comcast.net.
2.3 There are twenty counties that comprise C/EW, and some have as few as two people identified keeping the Democratic values torch burning. RAU's core belief is to rebuild the political infrastructure, and it is here that we can help. A team based in Yakima, with volunteers all across C/EW, is reaching out to Democratic organizations to offer support if needed for the important second contact for newly registered voters.Graph of Washington State New Voter Registrations.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/26OyGRKn2/c?w=fYfUcaH_Z5GxmH6mqZyDNhMnpBL2xbXFY1fzGnYyHJk.)
---
| | We know that it takes multiple contacts to prompt action from a person. With first-time young voters supporting Trump 3:1 over Biden and newly registered Latinx voters still showing low voter turnout, it is critically important to maintain a level of connection. We are offering to send postcards to all newly registered voters to let them know that others who believe in Democratic values are here, organized, and can offer support and guidance.If you are an organization active in voter registration or new voter outreach, we would like to hear from you.
---
| | |
---
| | We need your support! Thanks to your incredible generosity and belief in our communities, we've grown faster and achieved more than we ever imagined. But to keep pushing Democratic values into the heart of rural Washington, we need your help. Please consider making a generous monthly donation to support our cause. Every [contribution](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/26OyGRKn2/c?w=hGnlOSXT0k7sn6IzzdVV_YZzz2Zq1PATY9ld_XsV0OE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL25ld3NsZXR0ZXItYXByaWwtMjAyNCIsInIiOiI3NDY3NTY5Zi1kYTAzLTQ3OTUtOWU3ZS1kOTM2OTRkYjE0MmYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) makes a difference!

| | 3\. Unveiling Yakima's MAGA-Driven City Council Power Play: Exposing Local Governance's Disturbing Reality
---
| | What has been shared in previous newsletters are fragments that comprise a larger picture: a concerted effort to seize control of local government, reshape it as an effective tool, and impose a narrow and unpopular ideology on the majority, thereby distorting and corrupting the very foundation of our nation – democracy. ([read more in last newsletter](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/26OyGRKn2/c?w=UIKqweDXaR_28-etJhuwCV0YSyKoo3JFEbybhpP-Hf8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3QvcnVyYWwtdm9pY2VzLXJlc3RvcmluZy1lcXVpdHktdG8tb3VyLWVsZWN0aW9uLXByb2Nlc3MiLCJyIjoiNmZmZDVlYTUtYTI3MC00ZjBiLThhOWQtMzFlYzVmYjRlMGY5IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0))The MAGA members of the Yakima City Council (MMYCC) recently moved to diminish community input on council decisions by disconnecting from several Community Committees addressing issues such as Climate and Diversity. These committees previously had a legal bond with the Council, necessitating collaboration. However, MAGA's aversion to oversight led to their dissolution. Mayor Patricia Byers justified this action by stating that the committees could now operate more freely, but in reality, they have been stripped of authority, leaving the MMYCC unaccountable to community input or oversight.This is not the first brazen attempt by the MMYCC to reshape the Council and local government to advance the Project 2025 agenda. It's alarming to witness how easily our government can be corrupted, with few checks in place to protect against such abuse.Project 2025, when implemented at the local level, is termed "Territorial Transformation." A Facebook post revealed that Yakima City Mayor Patricia Byers, Council member Mathew Brown, and Council member Chip Roy were welcoming [Sean Feucht](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/26OyGRKn2/c?w=lhppcb4UekNJuZJy8ujEAWhVDok7eKEhP6Ssx6QH7KU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BiLm9yZy9hcnRpY2xlLzIwMjMvMDgvMDEvcGFjaWZpYy1ub3J0aHdlc3QtZmFpdGgtbGVhZGVycy1kZW5vdW5jZS1zZWFuLWZldWNodC10b3VyLW92ZXItaGF0ZWZ1bC1yaGV0b3JpYy8iLCJyIjoiNmZmZDVlYTUtYTI3MC00ZjBiLThhOWQtMzFlYzVmYjRlMGY5IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) to Yakima's [SOZO Sports Complex on June 9, 2024](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/26OyGRKn2/c?w=3goPmhiU7T01FXuZZUre2HxIHSugsruqilvU1tikRBE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2V2ZW50cy83MjY5NDU0NjE5Nzg3Nzg4LyIsInIiOiI2ZmZkNWVhNS1hMjcwLTRmMGItOGE5ZC0zMWVjNWZiNGUwZjkiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ). Feucht's ministry espouses Christian Nationalism and is vehemently anti-LGBT, shedding light on why the Community Diversity and Inclusion Committee was axed by the MMYCC. Machinations are proceeding with disturbing precision.
---
| |
---
| | Lastly, the Yakima City Council's proclamation recognizing May 2, 2024, as National Prayer Day raises concerns. While a day of prayer may not be objectionable, falsely attributing a religious role in the founding of America undermines the secular nature of our government and the freedom to worship, or not, as one chooses.The purpose of starting the National Day of Prayer was to humbly come before God, seeking His guidance for our leaders and His grace upon us as a people. However, the first amendment of the constitution states, "Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion." Manipulating local government is shown to be more effective than State or Federal levels due to lesser oversight. Mayor Patricia Byers' reasoning for disconnecting the Community Committees from the government seems accurate for a day of prayer, but counter to the purpose of Community Committees.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/26OyGRKn2/c?w=tNSskX0FmmB_c_KbjrWy0RFcpMv_BxHFoE3Nou5E9J0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmF0aW9uYWxkYXlvZnByYXllci5vcmcvYWJvdXQiLCJyIjoiYzUyYzI0NjMtNzk0NS00YTFhLTlmMjEtZDU0NjllYzdhYjU4IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | |
---
| | Lastly, while a proclamation may not seem like a "serious" government action, [Washington State RCW 38.08.030](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/26OyGRKn2/c?w=h71l5o8EN2DZ4h_HGBbSjJswSnEfPXYOKt0rz9XaOs0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9hcHAubGVnLndhLmdvdi9yY3cvZGVmYXVsdC5hc3B4P2NpdGU9MzguMDguMDMwIiwiciI6ImYxNTgxYTlhLTFkNDktNDM4OS05ZDM3LTFiZjFmYmVjZjA1NSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) outlines a Proclamation of complete or limited martial law by the Governor. These small twists and turns gradually erode our trust in our system of government creating fear and confusion. In Central and Eastern Washington young voters were three times more likely to cast their ballot for Trump than for Biden and Democratic voter turnout was down 42%! Rural Americans United was created to fight back. We educate, remind and persuade people that Democratic Values mirror theirs the best and will provide a future that benefits us all. We provide a strong voice for Democratic Values across Central and Eastern Washington.

We hope that RAU continues to earn the trust of our partners and the communities we serve. 2.1 Our pro-Democratic messaging campaign has been a huge success. We have delivered over twenty million messages to the far-flung corners of Central and Eastern Washington (C/EW). However, we recognize that this is not enough. RAU has evaluated this strategy and determined that we can deliver much greater value. In May/June, we will hold a workshop that will include local organizations, entities invested in the success of rural Washington, community representatives, communications specialists, and data analysts. Together, we will design a program utilizing social media, direct-to-IP, and other communication networks to create a messaging strategy aimed at reaching youth, marginalized populations, and low voter turnout demographics. This will be the largest initiative of its kind ever conducted in C/EW.Using technology and messaging strategies, we will "listen" to these groups to understand why they are disconnected from the political process. This information will be used to develop tailored messaging campaigns and programs to support these groups in ways that are most relevant to them. The insights gained will be shared with campaigns, policymakers, non-profits, and others whose true intent is to serve and support democratic values. 2.2 The Octogenarian Peace Brigade is the working title for Shirley Grossman and Roz Luther's project with Rural Americans United. Based in Spokane Valley, these two dynamos will be hitting the road, traveling to small towns up and down Congressional District 5. While there's still much planning to be done, the premise is simple: elevate the voice and visibility of rural America. | | | | | By venturing into these small towns and either organizing events or participating in local ones, they aim to make marginalized people aware of their importance and to signal that work is underway to change the untenable circumstances they face due to far-right intimidation. Currently, we're reaching out to Democratic county parties in CD5 to seek permission and cooperation for this tour.We're fortunate to have experts like Glenn Rudolph, Chair of LD 13 (soon to become LD 15), lending their expertise. Glenn's understanding of one-on-one conversation techniques in far-right areas is invaluable.If you'd like more information or are able to support this project, please respond to this email or reach out to Shirley at emacap@comcast.net. 2.3 There are twenty counties that comprise C/EW, and some have as few as two people identified keeping the Democratic values torch burning. RAU's core belief is to rebuild the political infrastructure, and it is here that we can help. A team based in Yakima, with volunteers all across C/EW, is reaching out to Democratic organizations to offer support if needed for the important second contact for newly registered voters.Graph of Washington State New Voter Registrations. | | | | We know that it takes multiple contacts to prompt action from a person. With first-time young voters supporting Trump 3:1 over Biden and newly registered Latinx voters still showing low voter turnout, it is critically important to maintain a level of connection. We are offering to send postcards to all newly registered voters to let them know that others who believe in Democratic values are here, organized, and can offer support and guidance.If you are an organization active in voter registration or new voter outreach, we would like to hear from you. | | | | | We need your support! Thanks to your incredible generosity and belief in our communities, we've grown faster and achieved more than we ever imagined. But to keep pushing Democratic values into the heart of rural Washington, we need your help. Please consider making a generous monthly donation to support our cause. Every makes a difference! | | | | Our new mailing address is:420 S. 7nd AveSuite 180 PMB #110Yakima, WA 98908 | | | | | 3\. Unveiling Yakima's MAGA-Driven City Council Power Play: Exposing Local Governance's Disturbing Reality | | What has been shared in previous newsletters are fragments that comprise a larger picture: a concerted effort to seize control of local government, reshape it as an effective tool, and impose a narrow and unpopular ideology on the majority, thereby distorting and corrupting the very foundation of our nation – democracy. ( MAGA members of the Yakima City Council (MMYCC) recently moved to diminish community input on council decisions by disconnecting from several Community Committees addressing issues such as Climate and Diversity. These committees previously had a legal bond with the Council, necessitating collaboration. However, MAGA's aversion to oversight led to their dissolution. Mayor Patricia Byers justified this action by stating that the committees could now operate more freely, but in reality, they have been stripped of authority, leaving the MMYCC unaccountable to community input or oversight.This is not the first brazen attempt by the MMYCC to reshape the Council and local government to advance the Project 2025 agenda. It's alarming to witness how easily our government can be corrupted, with few checks in place to protect against such abuse.Project 2025, when implemented at the local level, is termed "Territorial Transformation." A Facebook post revealed that Yakima City Mayor Patricia Byers, Council member Mathew Brown, and Council member Chip Roy were welcoming to Yakima's . Feucht's ministry espouses Christian Nationalism and is vehemently anti-LGBT, shedding light on why the Community Diversity and Inclusion Committee was axed by the MMYCC. Machinations are proceeding with disturbing precision. | | | | Lastly, the Yakima City Council's proclamation recognizing May 2, 2024, as National Prayer Day raises concerns. While a day of prayer may not be objectionable, falsely attributing a religious role in the founding of America undermines the secular nature of our government and the freedom to worship, or not, as one chooses.The purpose of starting the National Day of Prayer was to humbly come before God, seeking His guidance for our leaders and His grace upon us as a people. However, the first amendment of the constitution states, "Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion." Manipulating local government is shown to be more effective than State or Federal levels due to lesser oversight. Mayor Patricia Byers' reasoning for disconnecting the Community Committees from the government seems accurate for a day of prayer, but counter to the purpose of Community Committees. | | | | | | | Lastly, while a proclamation may not seem like a "serious" government action, outlines a Proclamation of complete or limited martial law by the Governor. These small twists and turns gradually erode our trust in our system of government creating fear and confusion. In Central and Eastern Washington young voters were three times more likely to cast their ballot for Trump than for Biden and Democratic voter turnout was down 42%! Rural Americans United was created to fight back. We educate, remind and persuade people that Democratic Values mirror theirs the best and will provide a future that benefits us all. We provide a strong voice for Democratic Values across Central and Eastern Washington. | | | | | | | | | | | | Share on social | | | | This email was sent from .

It’s been a while since we last spoke, so I hope you’ll take the time to hear me out. I’m reaching out to you today not just as a former president, but as a fellow citizen who’s deeply invested in our country’s future. When I think back to the day Joe was elected president, I remember feeling a profound sense of hope, pride, and a great amount of relief. He’s dedicated his first term as president to rebuilding and healing our nation, and working to strengthen our democracy. But the journey doesn’t end there. The fight for our democracy, our rights, and our freedoms is happening _right now_ – **and winning starts with electing Democrats at _every_ level, especially in our state legislatures. ** [Let me be clear: Democrats are relying on your financial support to win this November. | | Republicans are making a play for New Jersey, and they're betting on Trump to carry them to victory. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83618620/468997004/-1197072038?refcode=2024-04-24-gop&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=ed6eae18-4802-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDZlYWUxOC00ODAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u0mwApzVn3GiIXxAfM-HQYOXfN0VI2Nz_0_QP5NlbVg=) **If Menendez runs as an Independent, we'll need the strongest, most battle-tested candidate possible to ensure he does not tip this seat into Republican hands.** While it is not clear who the GOP nominee will be, it is clear that New Jersey cannot afford to be the state that gives the Republican Party control of the Senate again. **I ran to stand up to Donald Trump.** I ran to protect my family and families like mine when my member of Congress threatened their healthcare. We have a situation going on in Missouri I think you need to know about.
#
Successful campaigns are all driven by priority, Peter.
There are internal priorities that we handle ourselves every day, like the budget and the schedule. But then there are everyone else’s priorities — the ones we can’t control, but could very well determine the outcome of this election.
So before I ask you to **[join our grassroots movement to defeat Josh Hawley and elect Lucas Kunce this year,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/48153?refcode=em20240424-5348&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5348%2E614464%2EnDAHP9) please let me tell you more about the situation we have going on in Missouri.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/48153?refcode=em20240424-5348&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5348%2E614464%2EnDAHP9)**
**Going into this election cycle, DC insiders knew Josh Hawley was vulnerable.** He was coming down from his stunt on January 6th, which rocked his approval ratings, fundraising, and in-state support base so much that several of his former mentors and mega-donors publicly abandoned his campaign.
But that wasn’t the only reason. Since Hawley’s last election, Missourians have voted overwhelmingly to take back their power by approving ballot measures to raise the minimum wage (2018), expand healthcare (2020), and legalize weed (2022) — signaling a clear break from the control-obsessed politicians like Hawley who’ve taken it upon themselves to rule over our lives.
**With all this information, those insiders decided to make Missouri’s U.S. Senate race their top defensive target in 2024.** They knew Hawley was weak running against a real warrior for working people like Lucas Kunce, so they’ve prioritized our race — doing, saying, and spending whatever it takes to prop up Hawley and tear Lucas down before voters head to the polls this November.
We’ve seen it since _literally_ the first day of this race, when they called Lucas “unhinged” for wanting to take on a coward like Hawley. And we’ve seen it every quarter since, as they transferred millions directly into Hawley’s campaign.
**They know just as well as we do — Hawley is vulnerable, and this election is our opportunity to defeat him and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.**

Now here’s where things get complicated. **With so many incumbents in tough races across the country this cycle, Missouri just hasn’t been a priority for the groups we’d typically see shoring up support for campaigns like ours.**
That’s why we need your help, Peter. If enough people like you decide to prioritize our race here in Missouri — which data shows is our most competitive and affordable chance to flip a U.S. Senate seat — we’ll be able to pull this off, defeat Josh Hawley, and elect Lucas Kunce this November.
I’m not kidding. Missouri has a smaller electorate and cheaper media markets than other states with targeted flip opportunities, like Texas and Florida. And multiple polls have already shown Lucas and Hawley in a _statistical tie_ for this Senate seat.
Your donation will stretch the furthest in Missouri — and it’ll have more of a direct impact on the outcome of this election. That’s just the truth.
**We need you to make Missouri’s U.S. Senate race a priority, Peter.**
**So now I’m going to ask you:[will you chip in $10 or just whatever feels right to you today so we can take advantage of this opportunity to flip a U.S. Senate seat and put Missouri on the map in 2024? Lucas isn’t taking any money from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Big Pharma execs in this race, so we mean it when we say that anything you can afford to give makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/48153?refcode=em20240424-5348&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5348%2E614464%2EnDAHP9)**

name: Maj. Gen. (Ret.) Paul Eaton
subject: Ukraine aid just passed the U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS ACTION FUND
body:
Thanks to you, the light of democracy will not go out in Ukraine. Lives will be saved. Further conflict will be prevented. Putin can be defeated.
#
Derek, today is a good day.
After months of effort — member fly-ins to the Capitol, lobbying, grassroots pressure, press conferences with Democratic leadership and Veterans, targeted ad buys from coast to coast, and many, many emails — the Senate just passed the bipartisan National Security package that will fund Ukraine in their fight against Russia.
This was no easy task. It took far, far too long. But Ukraine’s warriors will get what they need to defend their land against Putin.
To those of you who have been involved throughout this process — whether you chipped in your hard-earned money to help cover the hundreds of thousands we spent on advertisements and media, wrote or called your Senators or members of Congress, signed petitions, or just followed along — this is your victory.
Thanks to you, the light of democracy will not go out in Ukraine. Lives will be saved. Further conflict will be prevented. Putin can be defeated.
We’re grateful for you, and for the leadership of the Democratic Party and VoteVets members over the last several months as they guided this deal to passage. From the House, to the Senate, to the White House.
So today, we’re asking you to let them know that we appreciate their work.
[**Use this link and add your name to thank President Biden and Democratic members of the House and Senate for all of their efforts in getting this aid package across the finish line.](https://act.votevets.org/signup/240424_vv_em_ukraine_thanks/?source=em240424-1-30?refcode2=25067.3013755.XZoanP&akid=25067%2E3013755%2EXZoanP)**
| [THANK OUR LEADERS](https://act.votevets.org/signup/240424_vv_em_ukraine_thanks/?source=em240424-1-30?refcode2=25067.3013755.XZoanP&akid=25067%2E3013755%2EXZoanP)
---
This would not have happened without you. We really mean that.
Thank you very much,
Maj. Gen. Paul Eaton
U.S. Army, Retired

Former President Donald Trump on Tuesday reaped a stock bonus of around $1.2 billion for his shares in Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG). | Hi there,

This week, **the Biden administration launched its American Climate Corps (ACC) website** , which already holds nearly **2,000** climate and clean energy jobs in 36 states, DC, and Puerto Rico—with more postings coming every two weeks.

It would be an understatement to say that I’m very excited. (I have no fewer than two Climate Corps posters hanging up in my living room and a Climate Corps t-shirt.) I'm on a mission to get others just as excited about the Corps as me—and there are more than enough reasons to be!

**The new American Climate Corps is for all Americans** —regardless of education, ability, or anything else. If you're interested in a career that tackles the climate crisis head-on, then the Climate Corps might be right for you.

Don't take it just from me—[**check out this fun (highly unscientific) quiz we made.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2501157/87SdQ4wZ) It might shake up the image you have of what a "typical" corpsmember looks like! |

**One of the most important free speech cases of our time is going before the Supreme Court, and you probably haven 't heard about it.** Right now, both Texas and Florida are battling to uphold their common-sense bills that prohibit viewpoint discrimination on social media. These bills were passed for a reason -- conservative voices are being suppressed. Disfavored opinions (and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that's not an exaggeration; we've experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we told a joke that referred to a male person ("Admiral" Rachel Levine) as a man. It's gotten completely out of hand. Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values. **_That 's why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws._**
---
[Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=167761ad379943f49aff361c2b20008a&_e=X4sn0gC-0iYmjKl8-0XTfa1Wj6nFNvtCgpUyUnlx8nJAzEEKYfCYwtMxb6GFUha1benkW5EQsZn-SR_MBQxgig67NHpsiraqeFy7X-k_KaN56k-gB5fmTKezRQjZ1tCivEgmkQbEQQ4_43XOJ6fny8BXwWBZdsU7DrxEdz6PGfjnLiVhOYLELfeVuo_5KQ7m6rBxjbx-7j52VCQjFsgcrYXNUAtLpe9V-Xv5GLrTv_RnbGbiAAzrvK3zHXG_PwqGDZuGplTSyvhF3679qHY2EQ%3D%3D)

This is nothing new for us. We've long been committed to defending free speech in the public square. Here are some of the free speech battles we've taken on over the years:
* We filed an amicus brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in support of a humorist who was actually jailed because of a parody Facebook page.
* We sued the Attorney General's Office in the state of California to block the enforcement of a law requiring social media companies to regularly report "misinformation, disinformation, extremism, radicalization, and hate speech."
* We sued the New York Attorney General too, for the same censorship debauchery.
* We refused to delete a tweet that resulted in the suspension of our Twitter account with over 1 million followers
* We told Mark Zuckerberg he sucks

Fighting on the front lines for free speech in the public square isn't easy or inexpensive, but it's the right thing to do. And it's making a difference. Disfavored opinions (and even jokes) that are out of step with the progressive narrative have resulted in countless violations and suspensions. And that's not an exaggeration; we've experienced many cases of discriminatory censorship firsthand. In fact, we were locked out of Twitter for 8 months just because we told a joke that referred to a male person ("Admiral" Rachel Levine) as a man. It's gotten completely out of hand. Thankfully, Texas and Florida decided to do something about it. They drafted and passed legislation that would make it unlawful for big social media companies to engage in viewpoint discrimination. But, as expected, the social media companies challenged these laws, leading to an upcoming showdown at the Supreme Court. What the highest Court decides here will have far-reaching implications not just for us, but for everyone who uses social media to share their views and defend their values. **_That 's why Babylon Bee has filed an amicus brief in support of the Florida and Texas laws._**

Fellow Conservative,

Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress is a tale as old as the movie industry itself.

You and I both know how rare it is for a celebrity in Hollywood to support conservative candidates for federal office - it’s even more rare for them to offer their support publicly. But quite frankly, I couldn’t care less about winning the support of Hollywood actors, directors, or anyone involved with the entertainment industry.

**My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support.**

I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. Dear Derek, Tomorrow marks a significant milestone: **It’s officially been one year since President Biden and Vice President Harris launched their reelection campaign.** Over the last three years -- despite facing unprecedented challenges -- President Biden and Vice President Harris have made remarkable progress in advancing our nation’s values and delivering for the American people. Here are some of the Biden-Harris administration’s key accomplishments: ✅ The creation of 15 million new jobs in three years. ✅ The first meaningful gun violence reduction legislation in 30 years. ✅ A record number of Americans have health insurance coverage. ✅ The smallest racial wealth gap in 20 years. ✅ Lower costs, thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act -- which capped the cost of insulin at $35 for seniors on Medicare, lowered gas prices, and more. ✅ Historic debt relief for middle and working-class families. ✅ Protected marriage for LGBTQIA+ and interracial couples. I am incredibly proud of these accomplishments, and the work we’ve done together to make them a reality -- but it’s clear that our work is _far from over_. The threat Trump and MAGA extremists pose to our values looms large. While Democrats have focused on protecting democracy and moving our country forward, Republicans have remained in disarray, backing Trump’s presidential campaign regardless of his deeply harmful and unpopular agenda. **That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, Derek, to ask for your support as we navigate the months ahead. clean_body: Tomorrow marks one year since President Biden and Vice President Harris launched their reelection campaign. | | Dear Derek, Tomorrow marks a significant milestone: It’s officially been one year since President Biden and Vice President Harris launched their reelection campaign. Over the last three years -- despite facing unprecedented challenges -- President Biden and Vice President Harris have made remarkable progress in advancing our nation’s values and delivering for the American people. Here are some of the Biden-Harris administration’s key accomplishments: ✅ The creation of 15 million new jobs in three years. ✅ The first meaningful gun violence reduction legislation in 30 years. ✅ A record number of Americans have health insurance coverage. ✅ The smallest racial wealth gap in 20 years. ✅ Lower costs, thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act -- which capped the cost of insulin at $35 for seniors on Medicare, lowered gas prices, and more. ✅ Historic debt relief for middle and working-class families. ✅ Protected marriage for LGBTQIA+ and interracial couples. I am incredibly proud of these accomplishments, and the work we’ve done together to make them a reality -- but it’s clear that our work is far from over. The threat Trump and MAGA extremists pose to our values looms large. While Democrats have focused on protecting democracy and moving our country forward, Republicans have remained in disarray, backing Trump’s presidential campaign regardless of his deeply harmful and unpopular agenda. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, Derek, to ask for your support as we navigate the months ahead. I believe that together, we can shape a brighter future defined by compassion, inclusiveness, and opportunity for all Americans. Thank you for your unwavering support. subject: This fight is deeply personal to me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| I’m committed to doing everything I can to end the opioid epidemic.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2486%2E35263%2EAIGiDC)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-apr24.2z_qm-&refcode=AU_STB_CL_GEN_NOA_AC_20240424_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2486%2E35263%2EAIGiDC) Peter — When I hear Wisconsin families share how the opioid epidemic has wrecked their lives, I hear so many experiences I can relate to. **That’s because I’ve been there.** When I was young, I remember what it was like to come home from school and not be able to get into the house. I’d pound on the door, but my mother wouldn’t answer. She’d be passed out inside. My mother struggled with mental illness and addiction to prescription drugs her entire life. I began speaking candidly about her story after hearing from so many others who have been impacted by addiction. I know how hard this fight is. I know the stigma that comes with addiction and mental illness. This fight is deeply personal for me, as it is for too many Wisconsin families in every corner of our state. **So I’m committed to doing everything I can to end it.** In the Senate, I worked to pass bipartisan legislation and led efforts to secure a $1 billion emergency investment to fight the epidemic. I helped deliver life-saving resources to support local treatment, recovery, and prevention efforts. And I’m not done working to deliver even more for our communities. We’re stronger when we work together and listen to one another. **As any person who has felt the impact of the opioid crisis can tell you, this fight won’t be easy — but I believe we can make change when we work together and have somewhere to turn for help.** Thank you for reading this message today. I’m sharing my mother’s story with you because I know mental illness and addiction are nothing to be ashamed of. I think my mother would want to know that her story is helping others. — Tammy | | **Tammy is in the most competitive reelection fight of her life. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6295%2E5257348%2EDqRFmB ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek, can
I tell you a quick story about this photo?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=apr2024_abs_em.I2BRAI&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240424_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6295%2E5257348%2EDqRFmB ]Adam at his Harvard Law School Graduation

That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh
off a student research assistant job for Professor Laurence Tribe,
thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic
career. Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few
weeks away).

Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and
successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard
Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.

As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would
handle a case like that.

Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our
country ...

...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...

...serve on the January 6 Committee...

...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House
for doing the above...

...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the
personal threat of that corrupt president...

Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a
time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I
have been in a position to help do something about it.

In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

Anti-choice Republicans are trying to send us back 160 years |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83629546/469031503/-120062714?refcode=WTEFEP43_20240424_1864_ND_v1s1&sourceid=1053505&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlODUyMTYxMS01NTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oed4BHtY8gJ31AKN5rZVsJs5Ec9pxAej20BjYnVRumU=) Peter, **the Arizona Supreme Court just ruled that an _1864 abortion ban is enforceable today, in 2024_** _._

This ban — which was passed before women could vote, and before Arizona was even a state! — has no exceptions for rape or incest, and even goes so far as to prosecute and jail anyone who aids with abortions. (That includes friends, family, and doctors.)

Anti-choice Republicans were never going to stop at overturning _Roe v. Wade_. Now, they're trying to reinstate draconian laws from 160 years ago.

**To really drive home just how absurd and outdated this ban is, here's what else was going on in 1864:**
* The United States was in the midst of the Civil War.
* Arizona was nearly 50 years away from becoming a state.
* Nearly four million people were enslaved in the United States.
* Arizona's age of consent was set at _10 years old_.
* Women wouldn't start gaining the right to vote for another half-century.

**⬆️ That's the time period this abortion ban is from.**

Arizona is a huge battleground state this year, and EMILYs List women are running for offices up and down the ballot, taking on anti-choice Republicans and fighting for reproductive freedom. clean_body: Anti-choice Republicans are trying to send us back 160 years | = Peter, the Arizona Supreme Court just ruled that an 1864 abortion ban is enforceable today, in 2024 . This ban — which was passed before women could vote, and before Arizona was even a state! — has no exceptions for rape or incest, and even goes so far as to prosecute and jail anyone who aids with abortions. (That includes friends, family, and doctors.) Anti-choice Republicans were never going to stop at overturning Roe v. Wade. Now, they're trying to reinstate draconian laws from 160 years ago. To really drive home just how absurd and outdated this ban is, here's what else was going on in 1864: The United States was in the midst of the Civil War. Arizona was nearly 50 years away from becoming a state. Nearly four million people were enslaved in the United States. Arizona's age of consent was set at 10 years old. Women wouldn't start gaining the right to vote for another half-century. ⬆️ That's the time period this abortion ban is from.** Arizona is a huge battleground state this year, and EMILYs List women are running for offices up and down the ballot, taking on anti-choice Republicans and fighting for reproductive freedom. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for standing up for what's right, the EMILYs List team EMILYs List is a community of over five million members that helps elect Democratic pro-choice women to office. = = Paid for by EMILYs List and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. Folks,

I’m as nervous as a pregnant Jenny. **_April’s halfway over, and I’ve yet to meet any of my fundraising goals..._**

body:
Conservative-led anti-woke water company Freedom2o and Turning Point USA announced a new partnership today, as exclusively covered on Illinois Review.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this exclusive story from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

** Exclusive: Anti-Woke Water Company Freedom2o and Turning Point USA Announce Partnership as "Bottled With Liberal Tears" Brand Takes Market by Storm (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-anti-woke-water-company-freeedom2o-and-turning-point-usa-announce-partnership-as-bottled-with-liberal-tears-brand-takes-market-by-storm.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-anti-woke-water-company-freeedom2o-and-turning-point-usa-announce-partnership-as-bottled-with-liberal-tears-brand-takes-market-by-storm.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review

Conservative-led anti-woke water company Freedom2o (https://www.freedom2o.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) and Turning Point USA (https://www.tpusa.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – America’s largest and fastest-growing youth organization in the country announced on Wednesday a new partnership – as the “unapologetic” water bottle company offers to quench the thirst of conservative Republicans nationwide.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-anti-woke-water-company-freeedom2o-and-turning-point-usa-announce-partnership-as-bottled-with-liberal-tears-brand-takes-market-by-storm.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

In announcing the partnership that was shared exclusively with Illinois Review, TPUSA spokesman Andrew Kolvet said,

“Turning Point USA is thrilled to announce our collaboration with Freedom2o, a company deeply committed to championing free speech. As our official water sponsor, Freedom2o will provide refreshing hydration at TPUSA events, symbolizing our shared dedication to preserving liberty and empowering individuals to express themselves freely. Join us as we celebrate this partnership and continue our mission to uphold the principles of the First Amendment.”

In 2012, Charlie Kirk founded Turning Point as a 17-year old from the Chicagoland suburbs – and today, it has grown into the largest and fastest-growing youth movement in the United States with a presence in over 3,500 high school and college campuses and over 250,000 members nationwide.

Freedom2o founder and CEO Heather White calls the partnership with TPUSA a “perfect match.”

“We stand for the First Amendment, along with respect for life, liberty, and fiscal responsibility. These are values we proudly share with Turning Point USA, which makes our collaboration a perfect match. We’re excited about our partnership and embracing Freedom2o’s mission: To deliver bold, refreshing hydration that empowers YOU to use your voice without fear.”
The anti-woke water bottle company has been featured on The Megyn Kelly Show, Fox News, Bill O’Reilly, New York Post and Daily Mail. And each bottle of Freedom2o water comes with it’s own bold statement – totaling more than 60 so far, and includes sayings such as,

“Bottled with Liberal Tears.”
“This Water Isn’t Sleepy.”
“Drink This Water or Move to Canada.”
“This Water Ain’t Woke.”
“This Water Doesn’t Make Snowflakes.”
“You Can’t Censor Freedom.”
“One Nation Under God.”

The company was launched last Fall, and can be seen on billboards throughout the country. In October, Freedom2o appeared on a billboard in Times Square that read, “Taste of Freedom.” In addition to bottled water, you can purchase your own Freedom2o
apparel (https://www.freedom2o.com/collections/freedom2shop?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) including hats, shirts, mugs, can coolers and tumblers at the Freedom2o store.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/exclusive-anti-woke-water-company-freeedom2o-and-turning-point-usa-announce-partnership-as-bottled-with-liberal-tears-brand-takes-market-by-storm.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=134c5b6d0d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

And as a conservative, I recognize that it’s a violation of our constitutional freedoms for the “transgender” movement to ignore obvious distinctions between men and women —erasing equal opportunities that real women fought so hard to achieve and pass to future generations of women. My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I’m the CEO and Founder of the Center for American Liberty – a conservative not-for-profit law firm that is leading the charge against the woke transgender agenda. We’re suing Kaiser Permanente and the child mutilators who medically transitioned Chloe Cole to a “boy” when she was just 13 years old. Chloe did not give informed consent and now faces a lifetime of serious medical issues because of the drugs, hormones, and surgeries forced on her. We just sent a demand letter on behalf of a grandmother who was banned for life from her local YMCA because she confronted a man in the ladies’ locker room – who was wearing a women’s bathing suit and watching two little girls undress. The YMCA called the police on Julie, demonized her in the community, and banished her from the pool she frequented for 40 years. And we’re headed to the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals for a major hearing in the case of a California mother whose daughter was secretly transitioned to a “boy” at school. The fifth-grade child was given a new name, new pronouns, and new bathroom—all without so much as a phone call to mom for her permission. This radical school district robbed her mother, Aurora Regino, of her God-given parental rights to raise her child the way she sees fit. | | I won’t mince words... Robbing women of equal opportunities in college athletics AND forcing them to share locker rooms and showers with males is unacceptable. But that’s exactly what the NCAA is doing. It’s an attack on the God-given rights and constitutional freedoms of every American. And it’s up to you and me to stop it. Right here, right now. Your generous support will ensure we have the resources to win our groundbreaking litigation on behalf of Chloe, Julie, Aurora, and many others. More importantly, your signature on this vital petition will send a clear message – not just to the leaders in college athletics but to every radical leading a school district, hospital, or athletic facility in America – that you won’t tolerate this lunacy a moment longer. If the NAIA can protect women’s sports, so can the NCAA. Let’s build off this momentum. Thank you in advance for your support. God Bless, | | Harmeet K. name: Scott Parkinson
subject: LESS THAN TWO MONTHS FROM ELECTION DAY!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Parkinson for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Dear Friend, I hope this message finds you well and filled with the same energy and optimism that has been driving our campaign forward. Your unwavering support and hope for our country has been the backbone of our movement to save the middle class, restore parents’ rights in education, and enhance public safety in our Virginia communities. I am truly grateful for every step of this journey we've taken together, and we are just getting started! But look out! The Primary Election is already less than TWO months away, and early voting begins on May 3rd.
---
[DONATE NOW](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/638ea676cdd05cb5dc9f99905c540ea9/42903/a456a856ad5962963947229f28c3afba/da5a3182f3aebf15c3d6b838967d376c/42903)
---
**Early Voting** Early voting for the 2024 Republican Senate Primary begins on **Friday, May 3**. Please note will be able to vote at your local registrar, and the **last day to vote is Tuesday, June 18**.
---
[GET INVOLVED](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/638ea676cdd05cb5dc9f99905c540ea9/42903/a456a856ad5962963947229f28c3afba/3e212fe3f7d61257c3d6b838967d376c/42903)
---
**Weekly Review** This past week has been nothing short of invigorating as we've traversed our great Commonwealth - meeting with passionate Virginians who share our vision for a safer and more prosperous America. Here's a glimpse into our recent travels:

Nelson County Meet and Greet: Last Tuesday, I joined the Chair of the Nelson County Board of Supervisors, Jesse Rutherford, for a local meet and greet. The beer was great and the company was even better. Nelson is fired up to restore common-sense in Washington!
---
---
* Orange County 7th Congressional District Forum: I stopped by the Quad County Candidate Forum to support our fantastic slate of candidates for the 7th District in Orange County. Voters in the 7th District are ready for new representation in Congress, the Senate, and White House. They are laser focused on securing our border and unleashing the American economy. I’m committed to fully supporting our eventual nominee and ensuring this seat flips RED.

---
---
* Family Foundation Forum in Chesterfield: At the Family Foundation forum, we engaged in meaningful discussions about the importance of family values and the preservation of our constitutional freedoms. It was inspiring to see so many dedicated individuals come together to advocate for the principles we hold dear.

---
---
[CLICK HERE TO MAKE A CONTRIBUTION](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/638ea676cdd05cb5dc9f99905c540ea9/42903/a456a856ad5962963947229f28c3afba/ae8bcf702b79e208c3d6b838967d376c/42903)
---
| | **Latest Endorsements** Our campaign continues to pick up steam. In addition to the support of 5 Conservative U.S. Senators, the majority of the U.S. Freedom Caucus, and three Virginia Delegates – I am honored to have the support of leaders who share our commitment to conservative values:
* Mayor Rick West: Mayor West's endorsement is a testament to our shared dedication to serving the best interests of our communities. With his support, we will continue to fight for the issues that matter most to Virginians – including a lower cost of living.

---
---
* Former Congressman Randy Forbes and Shirley Forbes: I am deeply honored to have the support of Congressman Forbes and his wife, Shirley. Their decades of public service and unwavering dedication to conservative principles are an inspiration to us all.

---
---
* Delegate Eric Zehr: Del. Zehr is the 3rd Virginia Delegate to endorse my campaign, joining Ellen Campbell and AC Cordoza. As Senator, I’ll work with our state’s leaders to ensure there is synergy between the State and Federal government. Eric is a rising star in his district and a rock-solid conservative leader. I’m honored to have his support.

---
---
**Look Ahead:**

* **TONIGHT** : Loudoun County Debate with Larry O'Connor: Our campaign is gearing up for the Loudoun County Debate, where we will have the opportunity to present our vision for the future of Virginia. I am eager to engage in substantive discussions and demonstrate how federal policies impact the local community.

* **9th Congressional District:** On Thursday, we will be meeting with voters in Wythe County at Moon Dog Brick Oven at 12:30 PM. We are extremely excited to meet with voters in the 9th district as this will be followed by the Stafford Morris Dinner which is headlined by First Lady Suzanne Youngkin.

---
---
As we continue to build momentum and work tirelessly to earn the support of Virginians across the state, I am reminded of the incredible journey we are on together. With your steadfast support, we look forward to retiring Tim Kaine. Thank you once again for your unwavering dedication to our cause. Together, we will make history and usher in a new era of leadership for Virginia. Onward to Victory for Virginia! Scott T. Parkinson
---

We're going to win this!
The filings are in, and we've submitted the maximum number of nomination petitions to get on the ballot. We're fighting through November, but first things first - I do have a primary.
To come out of it strong, we must hit another crucial goal before our end-of-the-month deadline. Can you chip in? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Friends,
This year has been remarkable. When it comes to in-district fundraising, we are outraising our GOP incumbent opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman... but just barely.
Out of the five people in the race this year, more voters in MI01 have placed their faith in our vision than in any candidate from either party vying for the seat.
This metric is an excellent gauge of our grassroots support. I'm beyond grateful voters are feeling our momentum, but we must continue to outwork and out-organize the field. Unfortunately, it does require a lot of resources.
Friends, I'm a fierce proponent of campaign finance reform. But campaigns are expensive, and because of outside money , corporate PACs, and ultra-wealthy donors, in total, I'm still being outspent.
We can catch up.
Together, we will win in August and November, but to do it, I need you in my corner today. We're just 104 days away from the primary.
A contribution of any amount will help further poise me for a decisive victory. It's nothing I take lightly or for granted because it's very important.
We have work to do! Join us.
-Bob

name: John Fetterman
subject: Help keep PA’s Senate seat blue this November
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
At some point Republicans have *got* to learn that they can’t just run some rich guy from another state every year.
#
Derek,
Big news: the primaries are over here in PA and my friend + fellow PA Senator Bob Casey is now officially facing Republican David McCormick in the general election.
He’s a hedge fund executive who lives in CONNECTICUT and was hand-picked by Mitch McConnell. He also made a fortune selling out PA + American workers to China. It’s safe to say we need to step up for Bob *big* time in this election.
[**Will you split a donation between my campaign and Bob’s now to help us reach our end-of-month goal and defend this seat from Mitch McConnell and David McCormick?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240424-1?refcode=em20240424-1&amount=5&refcode2=8943_434096_0OD_Uy&akid=8943%2E434096%2E0OD_Uy)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240424-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240424-8943&refcode2=8943_434096_0OD_Uy&akid=8943%2E434096%2E0OD_Uy)**
At some point, Republicans have *got* to learn that they can’t just run some rich guy from another state every time they want to buy PA’s Senate seats. But they haven’t learned their lesson yet, so we’ve got to teach it to them again.
We can’t take this lightly though. Mitch McConnell and the GOP are going to do everything they can to try and defeat Bob, and McCormick has a massive personal fortune he’s already using to self-fund the race.
But we beat the Republicans in 2022, and we can do it again this November. We’re going to need your help to do it, though.
[**Derek, can we count on you to split a donation between my campaign and Bob’s before Tuesday’s end-of-month deadline? We need your help to reach our goal and keep the Senate blue.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240424-1?refcode=em20240424-1&amount=5&refcode2=8943_434096_0OD_Uy&akid=8943%2E434096%2E0OD_Uy)

Appreciate you all!!
❤️ John

U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

Friend,

_The New York Times_ is writing a story filled with frivolous lies about my childhood.

If it weren't so demeaning to my parents' lifelong teaching careers and the town I'm so proud to have been raised in, it might be funny.

The simple fact is _The New York Times_ is lying.

**Here's the truth : and I hope you will read all the way to the end. **

Growing up, we lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b7da621d32cb4f9986a996c12b2c142e&_e=2zE1PtAmh29P9SiU955h1vyjdsew0e0y6UyfCaXAxza3HJ49TQ4IIFn_0dALIFtn5ZOcT5hOa-0D9s_l_mTs-M4DBRoaJZUHu8RZeNEQ2nnQgiG_zyALSVsgyp3cSsQhwDOyV6iZDzd6HqaEPqxi7IEiy0YorERNtEwOp93wDA844V7GsJJd_dchoiRBEfYqVjNNtZdA7Iuulns4o0AlNLALjjixYtiEvdtu3FYsuMuUbOu2LtTNkUw5poUqOfcnCCV1VpVnd-A85iRoITwqC2WiN9gPhxabdTHrz05yHMpXQonyHZucCVNnu7_3OHymNrhZ5jaBzXr0bn_GEvBSt7hAW-4tjWMrFV1tSaZJNWKIldffcsgiP3SBWKzIv0xazmOivp-fadh1-FS9wmo86giC-RNiA31jDy4iQ5rgem0LSZk2m2s9G_tVSzoJToyKIOWFC4BYj6MHLZ13YjC5irutDsE6lyGkpglGd7d__9V14j6d5_qKr2nmrzNnpteh)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b7da621d32cb4f9986a996c12b2c142e&_e=2zE1PtAmh29P9SiU955h1vyjdsew0e0y6UyfCaXAxza3HJ49TQ4IIFn_0dALIFtn5ZOcT5hOa-0D9s_l_mTs-M4DBRoaJZUHu8RZeNEQ2nnQgiG_zyALSVsgyp3cSsQhwDOyV6iZDzd6HqaEPqxi7IEiy0YorERNtEwOp93wDA844V7GsJJd_dchoiRBEfYqVjNNtZdA7Iuulns4o0AlNLALjjixYtiEvdtu3FYsuMuUbOu2LtTNkUw5poUqOfcnCCV1VpVnd-A85iRoITwqC2WiN9gPhxabdTHrz05yHMpXQonyHZucCVNnu7_3OHymNrhZ5jaBzXr0bn_GEvBSt7hAW-4tjWMrFV1tSaZJNWL6S3prxvIhPHIpiKx7_VdopwpJ0o02uwVLA5HcAGJyKOG5lT658pY69TalIs3zlQlZLULUy_7NS4C_N41jA4CnI5GRVP-nvuFovaGPzS_JkJoB8jN5TuhgBsVQrQuo9xOoqss2lkekvk7lqGYTZDda)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg State University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b7da621d32cb4f9986a996c12b2c142e&_e=2zE1PtAmh29P9SiU955h1vyjdsew0e0y6UyfCaXAxza3HJ49TQ4IIFn_0dALIFtn5ZOcT5hOa-0D9s_l_mTs-M4DBRoaJZUHu8RZeNEQ2nnQgiG_zyALSVsgyp3cSsQhwDOyV6iZDzd6HqaEPqxi7IEiy0YorERNtEwOp93wDA844V7GsJJd_dchoiRBEfYqVjNNtZdA7Iuulns4o0AlNLALjjixYtiEvdtu3FYsuMuUbOu2LtTNkUw5poUqOfcnCCV1VpVnd-A85iRoITwqC2WiN9gPhxabdTHrz05yHMpXQonyHZucCVNnu7_3OHymNrhZ5jaBzXr0bn_GEvBSt7hAW-4tjWMrFV1tSaZJNWLRTj1OsbJIipatHqkCCF_RSzTkv24V-WvHrC8SuJuriBVj8fL51RGY2LyDmfHxXddZjGMY4IIBm6YYxOaF9J198MnqiwHn6cJTkNJwz7CIGL9KfbU-QPEsSHjRh5RypnDvrHtZSkrF1hh8enRZExRz)
It's incredible to me that this New York Times reporter somehow thinks this fact makes my dad "politically connected." **Does she know I 'm running against a career politician who's been riding his father's political coattails in elected office for three decades?**

I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it's sad to see we've fallen so far that one of our nation's oldest papers of record is pushing the Democrats' baked narrative.

I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg.
[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b7da621d32cb4f9986a996c12b2c142e&_e=2zE1PtAmh29P9SiU955h1vyjdsew0e0y6UyfCaXAxza3HJ49TQ4IIFn_0dALIFtn5ZOcT5hOa-0D9s_l_mTs-M4DBRoaJZUHu8RZeNEQ2nnQgiG_zyALSVsgyp3cSsQhwDOyV6iZDzd6HqaEPqxi7IEiy0YorERNtEwOp93wDA844V7GsJJd_dchoiRBEfYqVjNNtZdA7Iuulns4o0AlNLALjjixYtiEvdtu3FYsuMuUbOu2LtTNkUw5poUqOfcnCCV1VpVnd-A85iRoITwqC2WiN9gPhxabdTHrz05yHMpXQonyHZucCVNnu7_3OHymNrhZ5jaBzXr0bn_GEvBSt7hAW-4tjWMrFV1tSaZJNWLuhaubSdDGfksrH7XIqCaGQsQ28xPabpqHlZiFYfVK1mu5VR9coYtRK8MiotyChcN9Sf-Oj2bzamzUbm5h1-B4R91FuELM9imFjMTpbUVJSV8YjFmRlXrvRBkcY7RRu_OBvxx5IwxBHbf5bA1uuSVv)
It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point.

| Hi Friend,
The Republican majority in the U.S. House is tearing itself to pieces. They can't stop attacking each other long enough to get anything done to help the American people. I know that we can do better as Democrats, but we won't get that chance unless we can flip some key House districts from red to blue this November.
That's why I'm reaching out: Democrats have identified Texas Congressional District 31 as a must-win if they're going to retake the House.
I want to share why we here at Team Whitlow are confident that Democrat Stuart Whitlow can flip Texas Congressional District 31, [and ask for your support to help him do so.](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00132Tj3AzANwClCHTMQvYk7l-ZFAnjL82Xl3SqdK_2L_1p0JXfxObetSwrIkoFlzI-WCRwHlQ5jUNtJs_XMzzvLh2sdz7-GPR5_g-FMTg4muOS9vO5d416EC7jvsakRVH-LwAJTA7aWs5uSXAP_umRieC26AzwbI3v0LqBmnc78hogzLmi2PQyN-h6zMVaAKFgodUC7niR5blakl8HXxoJkQrB9N33lHn2&c=vgB_q8P7sL2_iKkuLTMKhCVSYVEw5OU1UyFXU1E02slpb0tK-gvv-Q==&ch=UlbD6AGYFiA-JR06DQ2tBKbHESlX3c1EsfhOypfH10JdSzsArkSmQA==) Let's start with whether District 31 can be flipped blue.
About twenty years ago, when TX-31 was created, the district was a safe seat for Republicans. A very safe seat. George W. Bush beat John Kerry by 34 points. Republican John Carter cruised into the House by 32 points.
Times have changed.
Austin has grown, and its northern suburbs in Williamson and Bell counties -- the two largest counties in TX-31 -- have seen tens of thousands of Democratic residents move in. Four years ago, Democrats closed the presidential election gap -- from 34 points in 2004 to just two in 2020. And the district has continued to get bluer every year since then.
Despite this, MAGA Republican John Carter still represents TX-31 in the House.
Even while his constituents increasingly lean blue, Carter has charged headfirst in the other direction. He recently co-signed a bill that would not just ban abortion, but also eliminate IVF nationally and prohibit common forms of birth control too. Hello,

name: Kevin Dellicker
subject: Election Wrap-Up
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KEVIN DELLICKER FOR CONGRESS
body:
Chickens, Eggs, and Politics |
---
| | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=af42b9d7d7&e=1090c5c412)
---
|
---
| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

I woke up this morning, let the chickens out of their coop, and said goodbye to my wife Susan. Then I cooked bacon and eggs for my son Jake, answered business emails, and delivered a Zoom presentation on cybersecurity. When that was over, I logged into my military account, signed promotion orders, and reviewed our upcoming training schedule.

In between, I called Ryan Mackenzie and congratulated him on his win. As promised, I offered him my endorsement. I also said I’d encourage my volunteers to support him. It’s important that we defeat Susan Wild this November, flip this congressional seat, and keep our Republican Majority.

This isn’t the outcome I intended. When I went to our post-election reception last evening, I hadn’t even considered a concession speech. I was that confident I was going to win.

But I didn’t. I understand chickens and eggs, my wife and sons, technology and cybersecurity, business and military affairs. But I still don’t understand politics. Perhaps I never will.

I’ve heard from volunteers and supporters who are upset and saddened by the results. Please don’t be discouraged. Our hope is not in this world (Heb 6:19).

I ran this race as if the survival of our nation depended upon me winning. And I offered this campaign and my community all the time, talent, and treasure I had to give.

But I also understand the limits of human endeavor (Pro 19:21), and that all authority comes from God (Rom 13:1). And because I trust in the will of our Sovereign Lord, I’m completely at peace with the outcome of this election. I hope you are too.

After collecting almost 4,000 signatures to get me on the ballot, my good friend Tom quipped, “Imagine if we were telling 4,000 people about Jesus instead.” Indeed. Maybe this new network of campaign friends will become a vehicle to spread the Gospel across the greater Lehigh Valley and beyond. Stay tuned.

In running for office, I wanted to make my family proud, my hometown proud, my volunteers proud. But you know what happened instead. You made me proud. Thank you for demonstrating such love for your country, your community, and your neighbors.

Today, for the first time in months, I’ll be on my front porch to greet my wife Susan as she comes home from work. I'm looking forward to that.

Thank you for the opportunity to serve as a candidate for Congress. I’m humbled by your support.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=32464843e8&e=1090c5c412)._

body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83645904/469079382/1636625507?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmI2NzNkZjYtNmUwMi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3z59VvfCTGEdbsC5QwWAJjSpkGPVT0POMFTv60xiBAo=) Friend, Over the course of eight years, 1.5 million Armenians were lost to a systematic genocide committed by the Ottoman Turks. 109 years later, we must remember the lives lost, the hopes and dreams destroyed forever. Today, even as the Armenian people thrive here in California, Armenians and Armenia continue to face ongoing threats and violence from Azerbaijan and Turkey. The world cannot be silent. Armenians deserve to live in peace in Armenia and in their ancestral homeland of Artsakh/Nagorno-Karabakh. It was my honor to present and author HR 82, a resolution commemorating this dark and tragic chapter in history. And I commend the Armenian people for their unwavering resilience. Our movement has always been about organizing in our most hard-to-reach communities, reaching out to people most campaigns don’t, and bringing people from all walks of life together to build a better future for everyone in Minnesota. This work isn’t easy, but it’s necessary.
This year’s elections will be no different. Donald Trump has been statistically TIED with President Biden in the last several polls conducted here in Minnesota. He knows that if he makes the investment, he has a real shot at winning here, and if he does, we’ll be facing a second Trump administration.
**But Peter, his attack ads, lies, and division can’t stand up against our people power when we’re running at full capacity. That’s why every fundraising deadline we have this year is critical. **
I just got an update from my campaign team. Right now, we’re only 25% of the way to our $20,000 end-of-month goal, and we have less than a week left to close the gap. Meeting these deadlines is the difference between expanding our operations on schedule to organize and keep Minnesota this November and taking a back seat in the most critical election of our lifetimes.

Yesterday, Pennsylvania held its Presidential Primary Election. Her Bold Move had phenomenal candidates on the ballot – and we have some good news to share!

**Several of our endorsed candidates made it through their elections and will be on the ballot in November.**

[**Each of the races we list below are CRITICAL to gaining pro-choice majorities in the rooms where decisions are being made. 🗳️ Janelle Stelson is moving on to the general for PA-10. She will face off with GOP extremist Scott Perry, who serves as head of the ultra-conservative Freedom Caucus. We are proud to support her effort to unseat him.

🗳️ Fern Leard is moving to the general for PA Assembly District 120. This seat is currently held by a Republican, but voter registration shows that her district is almost evenly split. This is a pickup opportunity for Democrats.

_“The need to rush funds to underfunded school districts is urgent. We have districts without libraries, schools without cafeterias, and schools that are consistently understaffed,” Fern said. “We are failing our children on many levels by not ensuring a high-quality public education that sets our students up for opportunities instead of strengthening the school-to-prison pipeline.”_

🗳️ Ashley Ehasz is moving to the General to represent Pennsylvania’s 1st Congressional District. She’ll be working to unseat GOP Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick, who recently sent a mailer to households in the district touting his conservative voting record.

He highlighted his support of the ‘Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act,’ which aims to spread misinformation about “late-term abortions.” (In reality, only 1% of abortions happen after 20 weeks – often due to dire and tragic circumstances.) He voted to cut the VA’s budget by 22% and blocked his own gun violence prevention measures.

This seat is flippable and one of our best chances at gaining another pro-choice Representative in Congress.

🗳️ Stefanie Rafes (PA Assembly District 187) ran unopposed and is automatically moving to the general. Her GOP opponent has been loudly anti-choice and has introduced legislation to restrict abortion access. Governor Josh Shapiro, a Democrat, won the district in 2022 by a relatively large margin. This is another strong opportunity to unseat an anti-choice legislator. We are working hard to make it happen.

**We couldn’t be more pleased to share this good news with you. Now that these candidates have made it through their primaries, we need to ensure that they have what they need to win in November. The stakes are high.**

clean_body: Yesterday was the presidential primary election in one of our key states, and we have the results! | | | | | = Hi Peter, Yesterday, Pennsylvania held its Presidential Primary Election. Her Bold Move had phenomenal candidates on the ballot – and we have some good news to share! Several of our endorsed candidates made it through their elections and will be on the ballot in November. = 🗳️ Janelle Stelson is moving on to the general for PA-10. She will face off with GOP extremist Scott Perry, who serves as head of the ultra-conservative Freedom Caucus. We are proud to support her effort to unseat him. 🗳️ Fern Leard is moving to the general for PA Assembly District 120. This seat is currently held by a Republican, but voter registration shows that her district is almost evenly split. This is a pickup opportunity for Democrats. “The need to rush funds to underfunded school districts is urgent. We have districts without libraries, schools without cafeterias, and schools that are consistently understaffed,” Fern said. “We are failing our children on many levels by not ensuring a high-quality public education that sets our students up for opportunities instead of strengthening the school-to-prison pipeline.” 🗳️ Ashley Ehasz is moving to the General to represent Pennsylvania’s 1st Congressional District. She’ll be working to unseat GOP Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick, who recently sent a mailer to households in the district touting his conservative voting record. He highlighted his support of the ‘Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act,’ which aims to spread misinformation about “late-term abortions.” (In reality, only 1% of abortions happen after 20 weeks – often due to dire and tragic circumstances.) He voted to cut the VA’s budget by 22% and blocked his own gun violence prevention measures. This seat is flippable and one of our best chances at gaining another pro-choice Representative in Congress. 🗳️ Stefanie Rafes (PA Assembly District 187) ran unopposed and is automatically moving to the general. Her GOP opponent has been loudly anti-choice and has introduced legislation to restrict abortion access. Governor Josh Shapiro, a Democrat, won the district in 2022 by a relatively large margin. This is another strong opportunity to unseat an anti-choice legislator. We are working hard to make it happen. We couldn’t be more pleased to share this good news with you. Peter, We've seen Joe Biden make some BAD decisions, but this one is the worst yet.

Biden's nomination of Adeel Mangi to the 3rd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals spits in the face of our judiciary and poses a serious threat to the nation.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3113cb2d015946a7a80fa110fade004e&_e=W2VbPxK1iuUvXb0c3HT-Y0BTGaed5I1hGDiSCBWeb_AFxDlakX4k0fOX0HnaUwuYva92dlpHTnfxvXrWK_0XjWjOxLuDT8a5-Z9ZewqAPE15gDiROj4p2FQD9bHorC6s6hlVDUpIgTtHNzqEX6IK6tM7g4KkXLYJnnWEHjZ1wRn4DO2GyWQNebTdwD1AWJv5q1dMNvg5dUHeZVtJFWdsXQzQORMn3VyUI8dR71TsWbPfN6GVUnLEHNIm-FyqWNru3wbBSej7-KiowK1HaW5P_rtS5Hrcux9zjvh5sUD_49kWCI5RIXalBfvVK3q1IiJv872Hey2cxoX1-JKScT3vuHN6joVPEcQN7ejgzIe4W_jJAYGiM_FJMm2VHJ3wqSUJssEOZFeNoVSlgunKvmGFLw%3D%3D)
---
**He is well-known for his ties to not one, but TWO extremist organizations that support terrorists and cop killers...**

❌Mangi is a current advisory board member for the Alliance of Families for Justice (AFJ). The AFJ is infamous because founding board member Kathy Boudin _pleaded guilty to the felony murder of two police officers in 1981. _

❌He also previously served on the board of advisers for the Rutgers University Center for Security, Race and Rights (CSRR). This organization _continuously hosts events featuring known terrorist supporters. _

**The consequences of confirming Mr. Mangi to the federal bench are dire.** We cannot afford to entrust the future of our judiciary to someone with such questionable (at best) allegiances and values.

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Friend, my motto has always been that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. That's what I'm doing every day in the Senate.
**I'm fighting for the Dignity of Work.** No matter where you're from or what kind of work you do, hard work should pay off for everyone. Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you.
**I'm fighting for accountability.** For years, we've seen corporations lobby for tax breaks and bad trade deals that hurt workers. I'm not afraid to stand up to Wall Street or take on Big Pharma to level the playing field.

Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or make tips, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you. I'm fighting for accountability. For years, we've seen corporations lobby for tax breaks and bad trade deals that hurt workers. I'm not afraid to stand up to Wall Street or take on Big Pharma to level the playing field. I'm fighting for our fundamental rights. My opponent has made it clear he doesn’t have our best interests at heart. I will always fight for a more equal and inclusive country. But here's the deal, friend: I need you to fight with me. I'm facing my toughest race yet, and polls show me neck and neck with my Trump-backed opponent. He’s spending millions of dollars to flip this seat and the Senate red, and I can't fight back without your help. = Thank you, = | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

It's been incredible seeing all of the support from la gente , united in the belief that we can continue achieving great things for South Texas.
But today, Friend, I wanted to reach out to you about something that is very important to me— your endorsement.
