With gratitude,
Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://ljm2lks2.paperform.co [https://ljm2lks2.paperform.co]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

body:
It’s time to put power back in the hands of the people.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1190%2E62735%2EcPxGZx)
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1320?t=2&akid=1190%2E62735%2EcPxGZx)
If you’ve been reading our emails, Peter, you know that there’s a SERIOUS problem with corporate money in our political system. What you might not know is just **how bad the problem has gotten in recent years:**
* 👎 Business interests outspent organized labor **_14-to-1_ in the last election cycle**
* 👎 Corporate PACs and industry trade groups have steered over **$108 million to election objectors since the Jan. 6 insurrection**
* 👎 The fossil fuel industry has been able to spend **27 times more** than climate advocacy groups to stall climate action

How can we prioritize American workers in Washington if their employers are bankrolling campaigns? How can we promote a healthy democracy or planet when corporations are spending millions to prop up their interests?
The short answer is: _We can't._
To change the status quo, **we need to elect Hill Harper to the U.S. Senate — a fresh, new leader who hasn’t been paid out by Washington’s broken system.**
In fact, that’s why Hill jumped in this race in the first place: He knows we won’t get the change we need by sending the same bought-and-paid-for politicians back to Washington. Instead, he’s running as a single father, union board member, and community activist who believes in a government that serves ALL its people — not just the wealthy and well-connected.

clean_body: It’s time to put power back in the hands of the people. If you’ve been reading our emails, Peter, you know that there’s a SERIOUS problem with corporate money in our political system. What you might not know is just how bad the problem has gotten in recent years: 👎 Business interests outspent organized labor 14-to-1 in the last election cycle 👎 Corporate PACs and industry trade groups have steered over $108 million to election objectors since the Jan. 6 insurrection 👎 The fossil fuel industry has been able to spend 27 times more than climate advocacy groups to stall climate action How can we prioritize American workers in Washington if their employers are bankrolling campaigns? How can we promote a healthy democracy or planet when corporations are spending millions to prop up their interests? The short answer is: We can't. To change the status quo, we need to elect Hill Harper to the U.S. Senate — a fresh, new leader who hasn’t been paid out by Washington’s broken system. In fact, that’s why Hill jumped in this race in the first place: He knows we won’t get the change we need by sending the same bought-and-paid-for politicians back to Washington. Instead, he’s running as a single father, union board member, and community activist who believes in a government that serves ALL its people — not just the wealthy and well-connected. So, with our campaign’s end-of-month deadline coming up on Tuesday, If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: With your support, we can elect Hill to the Senate and make Washington answer to the voters again — not corporations. Thanks for chipping in! \- Team Harper

GOP Nominee for Senate, Ohio

**Meet Bernie Moreno:** | [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=994c63d1742245f68724596a86029760&_e=zJvNqHjSac_f931dMyfJ7UDF9XrWgQ242j4YsQ4d37-HCxX9PuGgkkMLhTcSDZXh_Xx-awbwcy0rtlGS3gXVOkHXZw7hqt269DsH7tlI9dO6FWRuojNiw-RjqVArU1YRqx3-uvipFrdI9lF3gOodU_5v_LgY-_qhY1ki7NtUCqP7cDSJyBHhLPw6iFnWtjjKTzBN8kmbL_xoeAGmTL3Im1rAtHrb3o4XlA4Fzyu7k2fkYFL0ol9ei2FtAKS2MXI8kFzgSpy9YOSFFbJOJ2v-r0nCKf1gsbXBBFacaWzmieRkq4URHA1S_f8Dot21ZkPTiHobVs_LxZ_JyNOtuuSWGIFlEWnKzMnylDzE47AQO2pLmSSrkixx7IKz01_VDo3uBS10EuhMwePg4HV5uMx834UzGSWAx1vCehjzsI75qeU%3D) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

We're thrilled to announce a social media contest where you could win two tickets to the hot new Broadway musical "Suffs," a riveting portrayal of the courageous suffragists who fought tirelessly for women's right to vote. Following the performance, WFP's Nelini Stamp will be in conversation with the cast/creative team about the intersection of culture and movement. This groundbreaking production brings to life the historical events leading up to the ratification of the nineteenth amendment to the United States Constitution in 1920, a pivotal moment in history that paved the way for gender equality in the voting booth. Winners will be selected at random and announced on Monday, April 29. Not only will you have the chance to win two tickets to see "Suffs" on Broadway, but you'll also be promoting civic engagement and empowering your friends and families to participate in the democratic process. Together, let's honor the legacy of the suffragists by exercising our right to vote and being working families champions in our own communities. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to experience the inspiring story of the women’s suffrage movement firsthand. | Today, the Supreme Court will hear oral arguments assessing the legality of access to abortion in life-threatening medical emergencies.

This latest court case is an attempt to override the Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act, which requires emergency rooms to provide life-saving treatment, including access to abortions in health emergencies.

Women across the country are experiencing heartbreaking, life-threatening circumstances as they’re denied the healthcare they need. This is a reality we can’t accept.

_**Personal healthcare decisions should be made by a woman and her doctor, not by politicians. I was proud to cast the first pro-choice vote in West Michigan history.**_ My work does not stop here. I am committed to advocating for the equal rights of West Michiganders and continuing to fight for reproductive freedom.

Republicans are telling us they’ll continue chipping away at rights to access, travel, and anything that intersects with our reproductive freedom. We should believe them. And then we should deny them that opportunity.

Republicans are coming for our district and doing everything they can to clinch and expand their narrow majority. I hope you’ll continue supporting my campaign as I work to protect reproductive rights in Congress.

Please, I’m asking–as a woman and a mother myself–please help support the work I’m doing to ensure women and girls are protected for generations to come. I can’t do this without you.

Grateful,

Hillary
---

| Peter,

These days, I’ve been spending most of my time on the campaign trail. It’s one of my favorite parts of campaigning... yes, even when I’m stuck without cell reception and running low on gas. Talk about cell phone bars - too often, I’m the only “Barr” in the car. Ha!

**Let me explain.**

Here’s a map of our district.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83655942/469104884/-1887195573?refcode=BLU_EM_CBC_2024-04-24_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTdiN2VkN2QtODAwMi1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dIIge6dSKHvhGqwukGVoAzGoDxrG5QehahupXyDskOI=)
We are Michigan’s biggest Congressional district geographically, but we’re also pretty sparse. **When it comes to basic utilities, rural communities like ours typically bear the brunt of a lack of infrastructure development.**

It’s an issue that’s been present in my life for as long as I can remember, and it’s really noticeable when you’re traveling from one end of our district to the other. I’ve had to make accommodations with my team to ensure we’re communicating to the best of our ability, and sometimes that just means I’m optimistically yelling, “Can you hear me now?”

**_Upper and Northern Michiganders need investments in rural broadband, plain and simple. A congressman like Bergman, who votes against that funding, shouldn’t be in office._ [_I’m running for Congress to give us a seat at the table and ensure we break down digital equity barriers. Team,

It's been a while since I shared my background with you, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about myself and explain why I'm running to return to Congress. [**Before I dive in, if you're already on board, you can chip in here before my end-of-month deadline to help me flip NY-17 >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83656566/469106129/132774807?refcode=em24_240424_eom1_fnd_gq_act___mj_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240424_eom1_fnd_gq_act___mj_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=1584a0cd-8102-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTg0YTBjZC04MTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EAH-B2Y8Dtvf4kM7Mdc8P9hJ8FOWSuk4uPMZv9v8xDQ=)

**When I launched my first campaign in 2019, it felt like a long shot.** I was up against better-known and better-funded opponents.

Growing up poor, Black, and gay, I never saw anyone like me running for office, let alone the U.S. House of Representatives. But with the support of our grassroots movement, we defied the odds and won.

**I was proud to be part of the most productive Congress in modern history—fighting for working families, defending our democracy, and pushing to root out corruption.** But despite this and the other progress we made, New York’s redistricting and the establishment’s political machinations left me out of Congress.

**Right now, Mike Lawler represents my district after winning by only 1,820 votes.** Lawler will say anything he thinks you want to hear, but do whatever Donald Trump, Mike Johnson, and the extreme MAGA Republicans tell him to do when the cameras are off. He must be defeated in order for Democrats to retake the House.

**That’s why I'm not done fighting.** We've got a chance to send Lawler packing: In 2020, President Joe Biden won this House district by 10 points and election experts are calling this race a “toss-up.” **If we don’t flip NY-17, Democrats are simply not taking back the House in 2024.**

My team set a huge end-of-month fundraising goal to help propel my campaign all the way to November. Team, It's been a while since I shared my background with you, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about myself and explain why I'm running to return to Congress. = When I launched my first campaign in 2019, it felt like a long shot. I was up against better-known and better-funded opponents. Growing up poor, Black, and gay, I never saw anyone like me running for office, let alone the U.S. House of Representatives. But with the support of our grassroots movement, we defied the odds and won. I was proud to be part of the most productive Congress in modern history—fighting for working families, defending our democracy, and pushing to root out corruption. But despite this and the other progress we made, New York’s redistricting and the establishment’s political machinations left me out of Congress. Right now, Mike Lawler represents my district after winning by only 1,820 votes. Lawler will say anything he thinks you want to hear, but do whatever Donald Trump, Mike Johnson, and the extreme MAGA Republicans tell him to do when the cameras are off. He must be defeated in order for Democrats to retake the House. That’s why I'm not done fighting. We've got a chance to send Lawler packing: In 2020, President Joe Biden won this House district by 10 points and election experts are calling this race a “toss-up.” If we don’t flip NY-17, Democrats are simply not taking back the House in 2024. Right now, it seems like a popular thing in Washington, D.C., is to tell people you will do one thing and then turn around and do the opposite.

Growing up, my mother would call that fibbing.

You might know it as **lying.** Others might even refer to it as **hogwash. Baloney. Bull.**

Frankly, I can’t stand it.

Because my momma didn’t raise a fool, and if she did it was one of my brothers! I may not always the most brilliant guy in the room or the best-looking, but I know BS when I see it. So, I pride myself on being honest and never giving you the runaround.

**If I tell you a flea can pull a wagon,_load it up._**

Right now, we’re in an all-out brawl against the Socialist Left for common sense in our country. **As we barrel on through this election year, taking action isn’t just a choice; it’s a requirement.**

I’m happy to be on the front lines every single day.

Fighting to keep your family safe by securing our Southern Border.

Fighting to keep money in your wallet by helping straighten out the economy.

Fighting for your values every day from the Left-of-Lenin Neo-Socialist workers.

_All that I ask from you is to have my back._

Derek,
Katie Porter here. I’ve served in Congress both in the majority and minority, and let me tell you–we can get so much more done when Democrats control the House. _We need to flip just a few seats in November to make it happen._
**[That’s why today I’m asking you to support Truth to Power’s newly endorsed candidates, three Democrats who are rejecting corporate PAC money while running in tough, must win races.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240424?refcode=em20240424-38841&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38841_3422442_LGCTID&akid=38841%2E3422442%2ELGCTID)**
**Kirsten Engel** is running in a Tucson area district currently held by a Republican. Kirsten is a law professor (like I was!) and worked to protect the environment. As a state legislator, she fought Republican attempts to cut education and worked to fully-fund Arizona public schools and universities. She lost by around 5,000 votes in 2022, so she just needs our help to get over the finish line in this important swing-state.
**Mondaire Jones** and I served together in Congress in 2021 and 2022, and I saw firsthand the type of principled leader he is. Now Mondaire is running in a Republican-held district in New York's Lower Hudson Valley. A majority of voters in this district voted for Joe Biden in 2020—so this seat is winnable.
As an attorney, **Josh Riley** has fought greedy cable company mergers, argued for ratification of the Equal Rights Amendment, and challenged the Trump Administration's racist Muslim Ban in the Supreme Court. Now he’s running to represent Upstate New York in what will be one of the most competitive House races of the year.
**[These three Democrats will be critical to flipping the House. Can you give $5 today that will be divided between their campaigns and Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240424?refcode=em20240424-38841&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38841_3422442_LGCTID&akid=38841%2E3422442%2ELGCTID)**

Thanks for considering,
Katie Porter

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240424-38841&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38841_3422442_LGCTID&akid=38841%2E3422442%2ELGCTID)**

# _**Your YDA April Newsletter**_
---
Happy April, Young Democrats! As we catch up, the whirlwind of events since our last newsletter has kept us on our toes. Across the political landscape, numerous primary elections have drawn to a close, marking significant milestones in the democratic process.

In legal proceedings, the commencement of Donald Trump's hush money trial in New York has captured widespread attention, further illuminating the threat he still poses to American Democracy. In other news, Congress' progress toward passing a bill to aid Ukraine signals a potential breakthrough after months of gridlock in the House but also illustrates the dysfunction and chaos of the current GOP majority.

As we navigate all these developments, the unfolding stories underscore how high the stakes are this November. We hope some of the opportunities in this month's newsletter can help you be better prepared for the necessary work ahead.
---
|
---

**_YDA Delegation is heading to the IFLRY General Assembly in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire 🇨🇮_**
---
The International Federation of Liberal Youth (IFLRY) is convening its General Assembly in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire from May 9th to the 12th, and YDA is excited to send a delegation to this significant event.

IFLRY is the worldwide federation of liberal youth organizations, and works to unite voices for democracy, human rights, and economic freedom. The assembly is a key nexus for liberal youth to exchange ideas, learn from one another, and strengthen international ties.

As we catch up, the whirlwind of events since our last newsletter has kept us on our toes. Across the political landscape, numerous primary elections have drawn to a close, marking significant milestones in the democratic process. Hey y’all! April has been action-packed here on Team Gloria! Although I’m still hard at work in the legislative session in Nashville, I’ve had the chance to get out on the campaign trail with our supporters, too! There’s nothing more energizing than getting together with the people who make up this movement. I’m in this race because of you, and connecting in person makes all the hard days worth it. Check out some photos from our recent events, and keep reading to see what else we’ve been up to this month 👇
* * *
🎵 Concert at City Winery 🎵 The Tennessee Young Professionals hosted a jam-packed jam session featuring performances by Brittany Howard, Allison Russell, and many more talented artists to drive up young voter turnout ahead of November’s critical elections. It was a fantastic night! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83658829/469110605/209297649?refcode=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOGI3MTlmZS04NTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wYc75LDXCahIYlbGLOvSSqnT4aq8G_nt_g-3SEdLuKw=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83658830/469110606/209297649?refcode=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOGI3MTlmZS04NTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wYc75LDXCahIYlbGLOvSSqnT4aq8G_nt_g-3SEdLuKw=)
* * *
💪 Standing With TN Students Against Gun Violence 💪 Young people are sick and tired of politicians who refuse to take real action to protect our communities from gun violence. In the year since the tragic school shooting in Nashville, more Tennesseans than ever have been making their anger known. Earlier this month, I joined a student-led protest against the TN GOP’s plan to arm school teachers instead of implementing any of the commonsense measures that we know actually curb gun violence. Students don’t want this, parents don’t want this, teachers don’t want this, and law enforcement officers don’t want this — yet the far-right Republicans in control of our state are pushing it through anyway. I know firsthand from my decades as a public educator that students cannot learn when they don’t feel safe. As Tennessee’s next Senator, I’ll fight right alongside these courageous young advocates for commonsense gun safety reform that _works_. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83658831/469110607/-2011171648?refcode=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOGI3MTlmZS04NTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wYc75LDXCahIYlbGLOvSSqnT4aq8G_nt_g-3SEdLuKw=&emci=486a2e93-4b02-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=46764483)
* * *
♀️ Sharing My Abortion Story ♀️ Women cannot be full and equal citizens without the freedom to make our own decisions about our bodies. I shared my story of choosing abortion when I was faced with a devastating medical diagnosis with the Associated Press. **[You can read it here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83658832/469110608/1846318001?taid=661aa1796ed4670001116fda&refcode=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOGI3MTlmZS04NTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wYc75LDXCahIYlbGLOvSSqnT4aq8G_nt_g-3SEdLuKw=&emci=486a2e93-4b02-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=46764483)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83658833/469110609/209297649?refcode=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOGI3MTlmZS04NTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wYc75LDXCahIYlbGLOvSSqnT4aq8G_nt_g-3SEdLuKw=)
* * *
🩺 On The Importance of Medicaid Promotion 🩺 This month, I once again spoke on the Assembly floor of the importance of promoting a healthier Tennessee. Health care access is a deeply personal issue to me. I’ve seen members of my own family struggle with medical issues that broke the bank. It’s why I’ve made passing Medicaid Expansion a priority of my time in the legislature — I’ve repeatedly introduced legislation to do so, but Republicans have shot it down. 40 states and Washington D.C. have already passed Medicaid Expansion, and Tennessee is leaving resources our communities deserve on the table by blocking it. It’d make communities healthier, provide funding for rural health care centers, and save Tennesseans’ lives. _More than 300,000 of our Tennessee neighbors could be covered under expansion_ — and I won’t stop fighting until we get this done. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83658834/469110610/1392399268?refcode=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOGI3MTlmZS04NTAyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wYc75LDXCahIYlbGLOvSSqnT4aq8G_nt_g-3SEdLuKw=&emci=486a2e93-4b02-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=08b719fe-8502-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=46764483)

clean_body: | Hey y’all! April has been action-packed here on Team Gloria! Although I’m still hard at work in the legislative session in Nashville, I’ve had the chance to get out on the campaign trail with our supporters, too! There’s nothing more energizing than getting together with the people who make up this movement. I’m in this race because of you, and connecting in person makes all the hard days worth it. Check out some photos from our recent events, and keep reading to see what else we’ve been up to this month 👇 🎵 Concert at City Winery 🎵 The Tennessee Young Professionals hosted a jam-packed jam session featuring performances by Brittany Howard, Allison Russell, and many more talented artists to drive up young voter turnout ahead of November’s critical elections. It was a fantastic night! = = 💪 Standing With TN Students Against Gun Violence 💪 Young people are sick and tired of politicians who refuse to take real action to protect our communities from gun violence. In the year since the tragic school shooting in Nashville, more Tennesseans than ever have been making their anger known. Earlier this month, I joined a student-led protest against the TN GOP’s plan to arm school teachers instead of implementing any of the commonsense measures that we know actually curb gun violence. Students don’t want this, parents don’t want this, teachers don’t want this, and law enforcement officers don’t want this — yet the far-right Republicans in control of our state are pushing it through anyway. I know firsthand from my decades as a public educator that students cannot learn when they don’t feel safe. As Tennessee’s next Senator, I’ll fight right alongside these courageous young advocates for commonsense gun safety reform that works. ♀️ Sharing My Abortion Story ♀️ Women cannot be full and equal citizens without the freedom to make our own decisions about our bodies. I shared my story of choosing abortion when I was faced with a devastating medical diagnosis with the Associated Press. = 🩺 On The Importance of Medicaid Promotion 🩺 This month, I once again spoke on the Assembly floor of the importance of promoting a healthier Tennessee. Health care access is a deeply personal issue to me. I’ve seen members of my own family struggle with medical issues that broke the bank. It’s why I’ve made passing Medicaid Expansion a priority of my time in the legislature — I’ve repeatedly introduced legislation to do so, but Republicans have shot it down. 40 states and Washington D.C. have already passed Medicaid Expansion, and Tennessee is leaving resources our communities deserve on the table by blocking it. It’d make communities healthier, provide funding for rural health care centers, and save Tennesseans’ lives. More than 300,000 of our Tennessee neighbors could be covered under expansion — and I won’t stop fighting until we get this done. 🧡 On the Campaign Trail & Around Tennessee! 💙 = The DeKalb Dems surprised me with this awesome cake. = I joined Gabby Giffords and Mark Kelly to talk about how to solve the epidemic of gun violence. = = I attended the Diane Nash Day Celebration and Gala to celebrate Diane Nash, the civil rights activist who led successful efforts to make Nashville the first city in the South to desegregate. = = I joined the Equity Alliance Rally last Wednesday to protest MAGA Republicans’ inaction on legislation that makes Tennessee safer. = I snapped a pic of the April 8th eclipse from Nashville! body:
The Biden administration appears to be using a federal agency to go
after a family that has donated significantly to Republicans by suing
its company for “racially discriminatory hiring practice” over
background checks.

[alt_text]

[*****]
April 24, 2024

[article-image]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=68040&L=32270&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZ292dC1zdWVzLXJlcHVibGljYW4tZG9ub3JzLWJpei8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Y29ycnVwdGlvbitjaHJvbmljbGVzJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=3244abd5015cb869730ac7c128d8646cf5290f40c5366ac0fe561bcade54ba22]

The Biden administration appears to be using a federal agency to go
after a family that has donated significantly to Republicans by suing
its company for “racially discriminatory hiring practice” over
background checks. The business, Sheetz Inc., is a chain of
convenience stores and the Sheetz family has long supported
Republicans in Pennsylvania and the Midwest, according
to records obtained by Judicial Watch. In the last few years, the
Sheetz’s have donated hundreds of thousands of dollars to Republican
causes and political candidates, including presidential candidate Mitt
Romney, Pennsylvania Senate candidate Dave McCormick and the National
Republican Congressional Committee. The most recent donation of
$24,500 by Chairman Steve Sheetz was made a few months ago to
McCormick, a Westpoint graduate and combat veteran endorsed by former
President Donald Trump.

In the last few years, the Sheetz’s have donated hundreds of thousands of dollars to Republican causes and political candidates, including presidential candidate Mitt Romney, Pennsylvania Senate candidate Dave McCormick and the National Republican Congressional Committee. body:
Mackenzie Wins Primary! | | | | |
---
**All I can say is THANK YOU!**
Thank you to the countless supporters who helped me become the Republican nominee to defeat Susan Wild. And thank you to the voters across our community for putting your faith in me.
Being the Republican nominee is something I take seriously. It gives me the opportunity to fight on behalf of the people of the Greater Lehigh Valley who have been abandoned by Joe Biden and Susan Wild.
I recently spoke with Kevin Dellicker and Maria Montero. They both graciously congratulated me on our victory, and offered support and encouragement in our effort to defeat extreme progressive Susan Wild. I hope to work with them and their supporters throughout this campaign. I also want to thank them for entering the arena and putting forth their ideas and issues - and for coming together now to unify our efforts toward victory this November.
**My promise is simple** : whether you voted for me or not, I am going to fight for you every day. On the campaign trail, that will mean holding Susan Wild accountable for the damage she has done to our country. And, if elected that means solving the real problems we face and helping the American people by putting them first.
Together, we can and will win this race in November. I look forward to working with you in the coming months to do just that.
Please join the team to help make it happen!
[JOIN THE TEAM](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=cc8c0d55ba&e=5ccada9200)
As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.
All the Best,
Ryan Mackenzie

Dear Peter,
Right now, we are facing monumental challenges that could shape our nation for generations to come, and the solutions we need _cannot be found_ in the status quo.
With stakes this high, stepping forward with determination is our only option. But before I go on, _I need to ask you to stay in this fight with me._
This campaign advances solely through the contributions of faithful supporters like you. This is a team effort, and _I can’t do it without 100% participation from every single friend we have!_
[As someone who has stood with us before, your continued support is crucial. Please consider making another contribution—whether it's $25, $50, or any amount you can spare.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mission_a_4_24_versiona_nd1a&n=5)

I can win this election, but we can't do it without your help. _And here are three reasons why we must win:_
|
1. 1. I believe that neither President Biden nor President Trump will navigate us through the looming debt crisis that threatens our country's very foundation.
2. Their strategies fall short in confronting the perpetual foreign conflicts. There’s no sign that either will halt the relentless cycle of these forever wars.
3. Nor do I see them severing the ties of vested interests that have led to the corporate capture of crucial agencies — whether it’s the Military Industrial Complex’s hold on the CIA, Big Pharma’s influence on the NIH, CDC, and FDA, or the USDA’s sway under Big Ag.

---
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=mission_a_4_24_versiona_nd1a&n=9)
---
If either Biden or Trump are elected, change will only graze the surface; we’re likely to see minor shifts in policy areas like taxation or abortion rights, but not the sweeping reforms we so desperately need.
No, they won’t dismantle our democracy within their term—the resilience of American institutions is formidable—their presidencies are simply not set to veer away from the well-worn path of politics as usual.
But here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance, to rejuvenate the spirit of our democracy, and to rebuild our nation's standing on a global scale.
| | **"Here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance."**
---
—Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.
This is about instilling a foreign policy not predicated on the show of military might but on the strength of our economy and the power of our values.
The possibility of enacting such pivotal change, of steering our country back to its principled course, is a calling too pivotal to ignore.
That's why the thought of backing down from this contest doesn’t cross my mind.
The prospect of what we can achieve together is immense, demanding unwavering commitment and a relentless pursuit of the vision we share for America.

But here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance, to rejuvenate the spirit of our democracy, and to rebuild our nation's standing on a global scale. | | "Here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance." —Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. This is about instilling a foreign policy not predicated on the show of military might but on the strength of our economy and the power of our values. The possibility of enacting such pivotal change, of steering our country back to its principled course, is a calling too pivotal to ignore. That's why the thought of backing down from this contest doesn’t cross my mind. The prospect of what we can achieve together is immense, demanding unwavering commitment and a relentless pursuit of the vision we share for America. | | | Sincerely, Robert F. [**Now that the general election is officially underway, we need to double down on our efforts. That’s why I’m personally asking if you’ll split $5 between my campaign and Ruben Gallego's to become a General Election Founding Donor.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-casey-split.V1z6EP&refcode=em240424-2-160&t=2&akid=2246%2E734936%2Etj-VV5)

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

I first ran for Congress because too many of us, from the Bronx to
Westchester, were being failed by a broken system.

As a school principal, I witnessed too many of our children dying of gun
violence with too little attention and action from those in power. Too
little being done to make life better and easier for working families. Too
little action on the climate crisis.

Justice Democrats recruited me to run against a 16-term incumbent and
establishment Democrat in 2020 — with support from progressive grassroots
supporters like you, we beat the odds and won.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jb.rltGKW&refcode=em20240424-34467&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34467%2E1203867%2EHSsP-G ]Now, I need your help again to fend off my AIPAC-backed moderate
challenger in this June’s primary election. Will you help re-elect me and
my fellow Squad members this year by splitting a donation to my campaign
and Justice Democrats today?

Together, we've stood up and delivered real progress for all, including
over $1 billion of funding for affordable housing, climate resiliency,
small businesses, gun violence prevention, and public schools in NY-16.

I’m keeping up the fight for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, student
debt relief, and human rights for Palestinians. But after I joined the
rest of the Squad in becoming the first members of Congress to call for a
ceasefire in Gaza last year, AIPAC vowed to spend $100 million against us
and recruited an out-of-touch, moderate Democrat to run against me.

My opponent has since made racist and Islamophobic comments and accepted
nearly $1 million from a super PAC bankrolled by Trump megadonors.

This is one of the most competitive Democratic primaries in the entire
country, and we simply can’t afford to lose this seat to another career
politician who will put corporate special interests before the people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jb.rltGKW&refcode=em20240424-34467&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=34467%2E1203867%2EHSsP-G ]That’s why I’m asking for your support today: can you rush
$5 or more to support me and fuel Justice Democrats’
campaign to Protect the Squad now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jb.rltGKW&refcode=em20240424-34467&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1021&akid=34467%2E1203867%2EHSsP-G ]Contribute $5

Peace and love,

Jamaal

Our planet can’t wait.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83660619/469113965/1328794144?refcode=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YzUxZGI2LTg3MDItZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8rUSBQgLMTUWDA-xnE47Q20o5naX0FnIgeT_dA8NaOc=&emci=672c2e1b-5202-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=4823105)
---
2023 was not only the hottest year on record but also a year of devastating climate-related disasters:
* _The U.S. battled over 25 billion-dollar climate events, ranging from catastrophic storms to overwhelming floods._
* _The Lahaina fire in Maui emerged as the deadliest U.S. wildfire in over a century._
* _Prolonged droughts devastated agriculture across the Southern and Midwestern states, while atmospheric rivers caused unprecedented flooding in California._

**Yet, amid these climate events, major broadcast TV networks like ABC, CBS, NBC, and FOX cut their climate coverage by a staggering 25% in 2023.** **[These unprecedented times for our planet deserve every ounce of attention, so today we're asking you to join us and demand that TV networks stop ignoring the climate crisis!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83660620/469113966/-1230006156?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&refcode=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YzUxZGI2LTg3MDItZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8rUSBQgLMTUWDA-xnE47Q20o5naX0FnIgeT_dA8NaOc=&emci=672c2e1b-5202-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=4823105)** | [**SIGN ON**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83660621/469113967/-1230006156?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&refcode=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YzUxZGI2LTg3MDItZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8rUSBQgLMTUWDA-xnE47Q20o5naX0FnIgeT_dA8NaOc=&emci=672c2e1b-5202-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=4823105)
---
While a 25% scale-back in coverage might not seem like much at first glance, it represents millions of people left in the dark about the escalating climate crisis — millions who could be taking action alongside us against the destructive fossil fuel industry.
Think about it: Reduced news coverage means the real stories behind the wildfires, droughts, and extreme weather events aren't receiving the attention they deserve. When people don't have the full story, they're unable to make informed decisions or mobilize effectively against Big Oil — and the sell-out politicians who vote in the industry’s interest.
That's why **we at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC are joining forces with our climate allies to demand TV networks stop ignoring the climate crisis.**
**[By signing this petition, you’re not only lending your voice to an important cause — you’re actually helping Jane PAC grow our online community of supporters.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83660622/469113968/-1230006156?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&refcode=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5YzUxZGI2LTg3MDItZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8rUSBQgLMTUWDA-xnE47Q20o5naX0FnIgeT_dA8NaOc=&emci=672c2e1b-5202-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=f9c51db6-8702-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=4823105)**
This is a moment for action. **Join us, and thousands of others, to ensure that the realities of the climate emergency are on display in every household, every policy discussion, and every newsroom.**

clean_body: Our planet can’t wait. | 2023 was not only the hottest year on record but also a year of devastating climate-related disasters: The U.S. battled over 25 billion-dollar climate events, ranging from catastrophic storms to overwhelming floods. The Lahaina fire in Maui emerged as the deadliest U.S. wildfire in over a century. Prolonged droughts devastated agriculture across the Southern and Midwestern states, while atmospheric rivers caused unprecedented flooding in California. Yet, amid these climate events, major broadcast TV networks like ABC, CBS, NBC, and FOX cut their climate coverage by a staggering 25% in 2023. | While a 25% scale-back in coverage might not seem like much at first glance, it represents millions of people left in the dark about the escalating climate crisis — millions who could be taking action alongside us against the destructive fossil fuel industry. Think about it: Reduced news coverage means the real stories behind the wildfires, droughts, and extreme weather events aren't receiving the attention they deserve. When people don't have the full story, they're unable to make informed decisions or mobilize effectively against Big Oil — and the sell-out politicians who vote in the industry’s interest. That's why we at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC are joining forces with our climate allies to demand TV networks stop ignoring the climate crisis. This is a moment for action. Join us, and thousands of others, to ensure that the realities of the climate emergency are on display in every household, every policy discussion, and every newsroom. 1. **[Joe Biden Signs Foreign Aid, TikTok Bills Into Law](https://substack.com/redirect/5873f1f7-dac4-44b5-9997-9d24d5cd7258?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

###### Joe Biden signed into law on Wednesday legislation that provides billions of dollars in aid to several countries and forces TikTok to divest from its Chinese parent company or face being banned in the United States.
###### The law [provides](https://substack.com/redirect/0ccb7ea2-b6f1-43a9-8d29-9ed211f50264?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $60 billion for Ukraine, $17 billion for Israel, $9 billion for humanitarian aid, and $8 billion to support Taiwan. A separate bill that Biden signed forces TikTok to be sold off from ByteDance, which is controlled by communist China.
2. **[AOC condemns calling cops over 'nonviolent demonstrations of young students.' Observers hit back with the facts."](https://substack.com/redirect/4699b69e-6055-491f-a4be-4393a8f54abe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

###### Far-left U.S. Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-N.Y.) not surprisingly appears to be fully backing the Hamas-loving, Israel-hating demonstrations that have been springing up with greater frequency on college campuses in the last couple of weeks.
3. **[Once upon a time, Joe Biden opposed the Iron Dome.](https://substack.com/redirect/93b9c445-37f8-4e3d-b415-bbdc90514113?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

###### Joe Biden hasn't just wreaked havoc on the world as president of the United States. Once upon a time, he did so as a senator, too.
4. **[Trump Holds Strong In Swing State Polling As Voters Skeptical Of Biden Economy](https://substack.com/redirect/a00751af-8a07-4a72-9a92-70eb828573d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

###### The [poll](https://substack.com/redirect/aeed08f8-5274-4fef-9e20-a94f662c6358?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of nearly 5,000 registered voters found that Trump leads Biden in key states like Arizona (49-42), Georgia (49-43), Nevada (51-43), North Carolina (51-41), Pennsylvania (47-46), and Wisconsin (48-44), while Biden tops Trump in Michigan (47-45). The majority of those polled had a negative view of the economy's direction, with many believing it would only get worse.
5. **[El Paso judge dismisses riot charges against 140 likely illegal aliens-- Republican DA indicts them anyway](https://substack.com/redirect/dd9790d7-c2ba-4276-9729-88777bf0d3d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

###### A district attorney in Texas has indicted 141 allegedly illegal aliens for riot participation just one day after a judge claimed there was no probable cause for doing so.
###### On April 12, a group of 300 or so individuals reportedly crossed the U.S. border illegally near Riverside High School in El Paso, Texas. Of those 300, 142 allegedly cut through a temporary fence constructed of concertina wire, an act that "constitutes an illegal entry into the U.S.," according to a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/1e66c771-dfb5-4837-ac4a-c64d5fd5d5df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Border Patrol.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: I want to talk a little about Summer
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
There is no pocket in this country where there is not someone fighting for justice.
Whether it’s Tennessee or The Bronx, Minnesota or California, there are fighters for justice everywhere.
And yesterday, they sent a resounding message that the city of Pittsburgh is not for sale by sending Summer Lee back to Congress — not by a little, but by **a lot.**
But this is about a larger battle for our country. We have billionaires funneling money because historically the law in politics has been ‘Whoever spends the most, wins’. AIPAC has pledged to spend $100 million to try and stop Summer and our entire progressive movement this year. [ Will you split a contribution between Courage to Change and our campaign today? Your support will have an immediate impact on progressive campaigns, their ability to organize, and their shot at victory.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240424.mYgCnm&refcode=em20240424-6261-P_FND_RES_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6261%2E2526796%2EgbHdio)
---
After Summer moved into Congress in 2022, it turns out her office is actually just a few doors down from mine.
But despite the fact that we are physically close, the way the House works is very isolating — you have different committees, all these things going on — and to be elected and to make history is to be significant, but it often means you are alone.
Summer Lee is the first Black woman to represent Pennsylvania in Congress — but to be first is to be alone. You are in a room, alone. Told you don’t know what you’re talking about, when really you are speaking from another perspective.
But they act like that means you don’t know.
I don’t know what it is to have billions of dollars and sleep at night defunding our public schools. I’ll admit that I don’t know how we can send billions and billions of dollars into a relentless war without even being able to afford our own housing or healthcare. I admit to not understanding that logic.
But I do know that to fight for common sense in the House of Representatives is to often be alone.
Yesterday, we showed Summer, and the world, that she is not alone. And every day she walks down that hallway, she walks with a million people by her side.
But this is about a larger battle for our country. Because we are in a moment where wealth has concentrated to absolutely unsustainable levels in the United States.
**They have purchased our political system** — it’s not just Republicans, it’s not just Democrats, it is the _system_ that is often purchased. We have billionaires funneling money because historically the law in politics has been ‘Whoever spends the most, wins’. That’s the brass tax.
And so when they want to take on someone like Summer — someone like us — they pour in money. And they’ve got big old slush funds for the 1%, like AIPAC for Republican millionaires, that think that they can buy our government.
**We have to show them that we are in a moment that is the _opposite_ of cynical.** Cynicism says, “The system is cooked, the outcomes are already predetermined, why bother?” — and that’s what they buy. They buy the amplification of saying ‘There’s no point. We shouldn’t try’.
What we are here to say is **our lives are worth fighting for.**
And they didn’t just try to buy this election – they’re trying to buy every election from the people who threaten them the most. Summer Lee was top of the ticket. But it’s not just Summer.
Jamaal Bowman. Cori Bush. Ilhan Omar.
I just got a primary challenger too. They’re trying.
Pittsburgh was the first of the rest of these races, and sent a message to the 1%: **it ain’t working anymore.** Our cities are not for sale anymore. We have woken up. We see this game for what it is. Your money isn’t good here anymore.
We’re going to protect our representation. We’re going to grow it, and expand it.
Westchester is not for sale. St. Louis won’t be for sale, either. The Bronx and Queens is never for sale. And it started in Pittsburgh yesterday.
Reject cynicism. A just America is worth fighting for.
**Our families are worth fighting for. Our wages, our lives, our healthcare, our education is worth fighting for.**
This year the left must win as many elections as possible to halt the immediate threat of fascism and expand our strength to chart a path of policy transformation in Congress. [We can, and must, do both. If you can, will you split a $5 contribution today between our campaign and Courage to Change, so we can grow our movement for transformative change?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240424.mYgCnm&refcode=em20240424-6261-P_FND_RES_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6261%2E2526796%2EgbHdio) **[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240424.mYgCnm&refcode=em20240424-6261-P_FND_RES_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6261%2E2526796%2EgbHdio)**
---
We will not give up.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20240424?refcode=em20240424-6261-P_FND_RES_CTC&t=22&refcode2=6261_2526796_gbHdio&akid=6261%2E2526796%2EgbHdio)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20240424-6261-P_FND_RES_CTC&t=23&akid=6261%2E2526796%2EgbHdio)**

clean_body: Another labor win from the Biden-Harris Administration | This just in, team: The Biden-Harris Administration just made millions of American workers eligible for overtime. This is another win in the long fight for fair wages and better benefits. Previously, only certain workers who made less than $36,000 were eligible for mandatory overtime. Now that’s been expanded to another 4 million workers. Anyone earning less than $58,656 per year will now be eligible for overtime. It's about damn time! This shouldn’t be controversial to say, but everyone should be paid fairly for the work they do. It’s up to us to make sure it stays that way. | Now even more teachers, nurses, factory workers, and retail employees have a chance to be paid what they deserve for the time they work. And let’s be clear: this happened because young voters nationwide made it clear to the Biden-Harris Administration that we wouldn’t stand for workers to be treated poorly. This is our victory, but our work isn’t finished yet. | Let's keep the momentum going, NextGen America | | = |

body:
| | | | | [](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=9da87191a8&e=3ef74f1f93)

Thank you for your interest in Hogan For Maryland!
If you missed us on our 10-day [**Back to Work Bus Tour**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=1bd005caef&e=3ef74f1f93)**,** don’t worry–there are plenty of more upcoming opportunities to catch Governor Hogan and the team on the trail or lend a helping hand. [**Sign up for volunteer updates today!**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=770edcefb9&e=3ef74f1f93)
**Looking Ahead:** Voting for the May 14th primary is already starting and mail-in ballots are being distributed across the state, and **early voting starts in just eight days!**
Spread the word to your family and friends, and cast your vote for Governor Hogan today by going to [**larryhogan.com/vote**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d275fff02f&e=3ef74f1f93) and requesting your mail-in ballot!
**Mark Your Calendar:** Hogan for Maryland is hosting a Back to Work Barbeque on Saturday, May 4th—and you’re invited! For more information, click [**here**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=eedc868547&e=3ef74f1f93).
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=fa6183e5fe&e=3ef74f1f93)
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7f7cc0e09f&e=3ef74f1f93)
Last week, Hogan for Maryland finished our [**Back to Work Bus Tour**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=e4f6a658b6&e=3ef74f1f93)**** with a bang in Koreatown!
By the end of the tour, Hogan for Maryland had traveled 1,286 miles to visit 113 stops across 19 counties and Baltimore City!
“Every single day of the Back to Work Bus Tour was a blessing. Meeting with Maryland families, shaking their hands, seeing communities across our great state—from Oakland to Perryville, we cannot thank enough the Marylanders who hosted us and the folks we met along the way who made this first leg of our journey so special,” **Governor Hogan said.** “We’re just getting started. We are not taking a single vote for granted—we will not be outworked. I look forward to working for your vote every day of this campaign.”
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=b14193ad97&e=3ef74f1f93)
Click [HERE](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=467133e9d6&e=3ef74f1f93) to watch and share the full recap video for our back to work bus tour!
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=2f60bc39a9&e=3ef74f1f93)
The bus tour got a lot of people talking, and reporters from across the state and around the country joined us on the tour to see what all the buzz was about.
In case you missed it, here were some other hits from the tour:
[Star Democrat:](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=0c1e43f1a2&e=3ef74f1f93) Former Gov. Larry Hogan spent a day on the Mid-Shore Friday, as his “Back to Work” bus tour came through Queen Anne’s, Caroline and Talbot counties...“A lot of people are frustrated that nothing ever seems to get done in Washington, and so I think they think I got a lot done while I was governor,” he said. “They think that there’s too much divisiveness, and dysfunction and gridlock... They think that a lot of the loudest, angriest voices get all the attention, and I think they’d rather send some straight-talking, common-sense leader to try to see if they can’t clean up the mess.”
[Cecil Whig:](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=af49c6278e&e=3ef74f1f93) Hogan said this bus tour started over a week ago with the goal of covering as many of Maryland's 23 counties as possible. "Most of the places we stopped at are small businesses, mom and pop stores, fire departments and sheriff's offices," he said. "We just want to say 'hello' to real people." The governor of Maryland from 2015-2022, Hogan said he got back into seeking office to work for the state and to fix "our nation's broken politics."
[Maryland Reporter:](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c6e5f5cff0&e=3ef74f1f93) “The T-shirts on Hogan’s staff on Sunday said: “Send a message to Washington.” What’s the message? “I’m like 70% of the people in America,” Hogan replied. “I’m completely fed up with politics as usual. I think I’m fed up with the divisiveness and dysfunction, gridlock and the angry, partisan name-calling and the fact that nobody ever really seems to want to get anything done, which is what I’m all about. Like what we’ve done in the past 10 years here in Maryland. I think that they could use a different voice...you can reach across the aisle and find common ground for the common good.”
See more [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d57103f0a0&e=3ef74f1f93).
**On the issues,** Governor Hogan slammed rising antisemitism on college campuses and made it clear hate has no home in Maryland:
Governor Hogan also spoke out against violent crime and soft on crime policies [today](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ebc3d514bc&e=3ef74f1f93), and reflected on the lessons learned from the 2015 Baltimore riots:
Read and share [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=a64d2faced&e=3ef74f1f93).
If you’d like to join us on our mission, [be sure to sign up to get involved with the campaign today!](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=e2fe526b15&e=3ef74f1f93)
Rob**Team Hogan**

name: Jasmyn Jordan
subject: I was attacked for being a black conservative
body:
Help students like me hear the truth... | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=51d232bc185348d8bbbf56c110e938b7&_t=k2Nvq0yo2K3et9am2fNutWmyq9UK0pNFTSJSgenaa_ye3_Oln0XYkQdfReWIG3RQFk88_aCmssxlNnUQwppRpEny3VwMbctYo3GiYNhRuZM%3D)_
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=51d232bc185348d8bbbf56c110e938b7&_e=PnIUkVH25UtuMKGm1U_eE2pM4hQZCnVIdQg4_HIK5yEAHepSfC3I_gyKZyZqKYNCvvujAR6Hza4MAs9FetcD466Fuk-v2ZIVwYuinSLJLkZhod0vJmD1NgASABC-6_TpV248LRHSy4hGs36yNAP7ecKfxwEaPPBJFbCcuHn-cv8IJw8D4cr-LkjVOmyoRXsyaunC1Phtdi8XcguTnvDKdy4FJGzNyKNArvrNAonmFElbSUfgmdW7mF5m3ECQ9h1N3Jp41KLjpErxXLw_tc4L-5UjJvH1laSLVmiJaUcmI0rb6rEfToi-u4bxL7krCBFspGZkP6z_TVrWP2l2FcrbvYfnZp-mtoeGwHi42_ciz1YDq-tegby9xInUA4YY463g)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=51d232bc185348d8bbbf56c110e938b7&_e=PnIUkVH25UtuMKGm1U_eE2pM4hQZCnVIdQg4_HIK5yEAHepSfC3I_gyKZyZqKYNCvvujAR6Hza4MAs9FetcD466Fuk-v2ZIVwYuinSLJLkZhod0vJmD1NgASABC-6_TpV248LRHSy4hGs36yNAP7ecKfxwEaPPBJFbCcuHn-cv8IJw8D4cr-LkjVOmyoRXsyaunC1Phtdi8XcguTnvDKd4P_I1y-ZTJ-cekAIkLii9xDyFTqKz8B5Ya1MrE-x9AacvBepdEzQGZ32XXyIOXxvwJfzKBeGmeS5jj0LVm51AKD1KkM_Bg3_hWNxYnd1qc9EzPDvmDfXRb7BFeRNk2jaQAOQrzmxp5NUJf1QVT4KEkHbus51USkD-RHhb8sfH9h)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! Peter, before I ask you to chip in to help us win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue, I want to take a moment to explain what our fight is all about.

**I've said it before, and I'll say it again: When you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work.** Whether you punch a clock or swipe a badge, earn a salary or work for tips, are raising children or caring for an elderly parent, I will _always_ fight for you.

Whether it's capping the cost of insulin, demanding better wages, or working to enshrine reproductive freedoms into law, I'm fighting for the issues that matter most to Ohioans. Because that is what I was elected to do.

I wanted you to be the first person I told Peter: **I’m officially running to flip Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District blue and be the only pro-choice OB/GYN in Congress.**

I have seen firsthand the effects of Wisconsin’s abortion ban – which stems from a law passed in 1849 that went into effect after _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned. Most doctors didn’t even know that germs caused diseases back then. It was nearly 70 years before women would even be allowed to cast their first votes.

**As a result of this draconian ban, I can no longer treat my patients and pregnant women in Wisconsin under threat of criminal prosecution.** Republicans have targeted my medical licenses and personally singled me out in their lawsuits for my work with Planned Parenthood to make me an example of what would happen to others who do the same.

As a result, I commute regularly to Minnesota and have traveled to Arizona to deliver babies and care for pregnant women. All across the country, women are traveling across state lines from states like Wisconsin that have stripped them and their families of the best medical options for them and their safety in order to seek reproductive care.

Our healthcare system is in crisis. Nurses and doctors are leaving the state and the profession in droves. Mothers and women are scared and confused. And it doesn’t have to be like this.

**With your help IT WON’T be like this in the future.** We are going to restore reproductive rights here in Wisconsin and all across the country. Which is why I decided it’s time to run for office.

Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District is an open seat that Democrats were just 3 points shy of carrying in 2018’s Senate election. With your help, we will flip it blue and win a pro-choice majority that will act to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law.

---
| | Dear Peter,

I won't deceive you, Peter, , I have been a supporter of Donald J. Trump for President for a considerable time. Perhaps that's why the Establishment introduced a New Republican opponent in my race against radical Democrat Steve Horsford. Enter John Lee, a lifelong Democrat deeply rooted in the Harry Reid political machine.

For nearly five months, I have been urging my New Republican opponent to join me in endorsing Trump, but I have been met with silence.
****
---
|
# If John Lee doesn't support Donald Trump, that's his choice, but he won't even respond to my challenge for a debate.

Voters and patriots like you have clearly seen this lack of backbone. You have overwhelmingly responded, and our campaign has raised nearly four times the amount raised by John Lee. Lee's hesitant embrace of Republican principles reveals a fundamental inconsistency in his political stance. His avoidance of Trump and refusal to engage in honest debate starkly contrasts with our campaign's transparent and steadfast approach.

# ****
---
| We are not here to simply participate; we are here to lead with integrity and dedication to the values that our community cherishes.

Now let’s finish the job and win this thing.
